items.endpoints_ja: 組織学的肝臓エンドポイント（histology-assessed hepatic endpoints）

items.title: Metformin-Associated Lactic Acidosis and Relative Euglycemic Ketoacidosis Precipitated by a Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonist: A Case Report and Literature Review.
items.abstract: Metformin-associated lactic acidosis (MALA) is an uncommon but often fatal complication of metformin therapy (incidence less than 10 per 100,000 patient-years; with a 30-50% mortality). MALA most commonly occurs with acute kidney injury, which impairs metformin excretion and inhibits mitochondrial complex I, shifting pyruvate metabolism toward lactate production. Euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (euDKA), classically defined as DKA with glucose below 250 mg/dL, is increasingly recognized not only with sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors but also with glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RA) through appetite suppression, vomiting, and reduced intake. Concurrent MALA and ketoacidosis with relative euglycemia is exceedingly rare, with no published synthesis of such cases to guide recognition or management. We present a case of severe MALA with ketoacidosis and relative euglycemia in a 59-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes on metformin and tirzepatide, managed successfully with emergent sequential hemodialysis and high-dose continuous venovenous hemodiafiltration. We also review reported MALA cases with GLP-1 RA use to identify shared precipitants, risk factors, and outcomes. The key lesson is that, in patients on metformin and a GLP-1 RA, gastrointestinal side effects can precipitate MALA, while a disproportionately low glucose can mask the accompanying ketoacidosis. Recognizing this pattern demands early measurement of serum beta-hydroxybutyrate and prompt initiation of renal replacement therapy.
items.authors: Adnani Harsha, Ladiwala Zoya, Lee Melinda, Patel Ami, King Joshua, Weir Matthew R
items.summary_ja: メトホルミン関連乳酸アシドーシス（MALA）は稀だが致死率の高い合併症であり、通常は急性腎障害を背景に発症する。一方、血糖値250 mg/dL未満の糖尿病ケトアシドーシス（euDKA）はSGLT2阻害薬だけでなくGLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）でも食欲抑制・嘔吐・摂取量減少を介して認識されつつある。本報告は、メトホルミンとtirzepatideを服用中の59歳女性2型糖尿病患者で、重度のMALAにケトアシドーシスおよび相対的血糖正常を伴った症例を提示し、緊急の連続血液透析および高用量持続静脈-静脈血液濾過透析（CVVHDF）により成功裏に治療した。さらに、GLP-1 RA使用を伴うMALA症例の文献レビューを行い、共通する誘因・リスク因子・予後を整理した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: メトホルミンとGLP-1 RAを併用中の患者では、消化管副作用がMALAを誘発し得る一方、相対的に低い血糖値が随伴するケトアシドーシスを隠蔽し得る。このパターンを認識するためには、血清β-ヒドロキシブチル酸の早期測定と腎代替療法の迅速な開始が求められる。
items.why_matters_ja: MALAとケトアシドーシスが相対的血糖正常を伴って同時に出現することは極めて稀であり、認識や管理を導くための公表された統合報告はこれまでなかった。GLP-1 RAの普及に伴い、メトホルミン併用患者でのこの合併症の認識が臨床的に重要となる。

items.title: Oral Incretin-Based Therapies for Weight Management.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: This paper aims to review the current development of oral incretin-based therapies for treatment of overweight and obesity, and outline the efficacy of upcoming therapeutic candidates as well as their safety profiles. Clinical recommendations are provided regarding the role of oral incretin-based therapies for treatment of overweight and obesity.
RECENT FINDINGS: Until recently, almost all incretin-based therapies have been injectable formulations due to limitations in absorption and bioavailability. Recently, novel techniques have emerged to overcome these barriers, with two agents (oral semaglutide and orforglipron) having obtained FDA approval; multiple other candidates are currently in development. Semaglutide is a peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist and orforglipron is a small-molecule biased GLP-1 receptor agonist approved for treatment of obesity; oral semaglutide is additionally approved for secondary cardiovascular risk reduction. In phase 3 trials, oral semaglutide and orforglipron have demonstrated clinically significant weight loss efficacy of > 10% with an adverse-event profile consistent with the GLP-1 class. Differences in formulations of novel oral agents result in differences in administration guidelines and potential risk of adverse events; with particular concern of drug-induced liver injury observed with first generation small-molecule incretin therapies. Overall, oral incretin-based therapies offer a promising new and potentially more accessible option for patients with overweight or obesity.
items.authors: Cheng Henry Evan, Bonafede Michael, Shukla Alpana P
items.summary_ja: 本レビューは、過体重・肥満の治療における経口インクレチン系療法の開発现状を総説する。従来のインクレチン系療法は吸収・生体利用率の限界によりほぼすべて注射製剤であったが、近年の技術革新により経口製剤の開発が進み、経口セマグルチド（ペプチドGLP-1受容体作動薬）とオルフォグリプロン（低分子バイアスGLP-1受容体作動薬）がFDA承認を取得した。第III相試験において両薬剤は10%超の臨床的に有意な減量効果を示し、有害事象プロファイルはGLP-1クラスと一致した。経口製剤の配合の違いにより投与ガイドラインや有害事象リスクに差異が生じ、初世代低分子インクレチン療法では薬剤性肝障害が特に懸念される。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 経口セマグルチドとオルフォグリプロンは第III相試験で10%超の減量効果を示し、過体重・肥満患者にとってよりアクセスしやすい有望な治療選択肢を提供する。
items.why_matters_ja: 従来のインクレチン系療法は注射製剤が中心であり、経口製剤の登場は患者のアドヒアランス向上と治療アクセスの拡大に寄与する可能性がある。また、経口製剤の配合差に伴う有害事象リスク（特に薬剤性肝障害）の理解は臨床実践上重要である。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 減量効果（体重減少率）、有害事象プロファイル
items.endpoint_results_ja: 経口セマグルチドおよびオルフォグリプロンは第III相試験で10%超の臨床的に有意な減量効果を示した。有害事象プロファイルはGLP-1クラスと一致した。

items.title: Efficacy and safety of canagliflozin are consistent across polypharmacy burden in CKD: the CREDENCE trial.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Polypharmacy in chronic kidney disease (CKD) is substantial. Clinicians and patients are often reluctant to add medications to already complex regimens, partly due to concerns about diminishing efficacy and increased adverse effects. We assessed whether efficacy and safety of canagliflozin is modified by polypharmacy status in patients with type 2 diabetes and CKD.
METHODS: We conducted a post-hoc analysis of the CREDENCE trial, which evaluated the effects of canagliflozin on outcomes in patients with type 2 diabetes and CKD. Participants were categorized as no polypharmacy (0-4 medicines), polypharmacy (5-9 medicines), or hyperpolypharmacy (≥10 medicines). We assessed the relative effects of canagliflozin on clinical and safety outcomes by polypharmacy status using Cox proportional hazards models. We assessed absolute benefits using Poisson regression. The primary outcome was a composite of doubling of serum creatinine, kidney failure or death due to cardiovascular or kidney disease.
RESULTS: Among 4401 participants, 612 (14%), 2404 (55%), and 1385 (31%) were categorized as no polypharmacy, polypharmacy and hyperpolypharmacy, respectively. Mean number of medications was 8.3 (SD 3.77). The effect of canagliflozin on kidney and cardiovascular outcomes was consistent irrespective of polypharmacy status, with no interaction observed for safety outcomes (all P-interaction > 0.06). Rates of treatment discontinuation increased with medication burden, but were lower with canagliflozin versus placebo, regardless of polypharmacy status (P-interaction = 0.16). Incidence of all-cause hospitalization, and heart failure hospitalization or cardiovascular death increased with higher medication burden, thus absolute risk reductions were estimated to be substantially greater in patients with polypharmacy and hyperpolypharmacy.
CONCLUSION: Among patients with type 2 diabetes and CKD, the efficacy and safety of canagliflozin appears consistent regardless of polypharmacy status, with larger estimated absolute reductions in hospitalizations and cardiovascular events in those experiencing polypharmacy or hyperpolypharmacy. These findings suggest that polypharmacy alone should not preclude consideration of SGLT2 inhibitor therapy in patients with CKD and type 2 diabetes for whom treatment is otherwise indicated.
items.journal: Nephrology, dialysis, transplantation : official publication of the European Dialysis and Transplant Association - European Renal Association
items.authors: Yeung Emily K, Siriwardana Amanda, Buizen Luke, Tang Arthur H C, Jun Min, Polkinghorne Kevan R, Tang Sydney C W, Kotwal Sradha
items.summary_ja: CREDENCE試験の事後解析として、2型糖尿病を合併した慢性腎臓病（CKD）患者において、カナグリフロジンの有効性及び安全性が多剤使用（ポリファーマシー）の状態によって変調されるかを評価した。参加者を非ポリファーマシー（0〜4剤）、ポリファーマシー（5〜9剤）、ハイパーポリファーマシー（10剤以上）に分類し、Cox比例ハザードモデルで相対効果、Poisson回帰で絶対的有益性を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: カナグリフロジンの腎・心血管アウトカムに対する効果はポリファーマシー状態に関わらず一貫しており、安全性アウトカムでも相互作用は認められなかった。ポリファーマシーまたはハイパーポリファーマシーの患者では、入院および心血管イベントの絶対的リスク低減がより大きいと推定された。
items.why_matters_ja: CKD患者におけるポリファーマシーは重大な問題であり、臨床医や患者は複雑な治療レジメンに薬剤を追加することに消極的である。本研究は、ポリファーマシー単独ではSGLT2阻害薬治療の検討を妨げるべきではないことを示唆し、臨床現場での治療判断に直接寄与する。
items.study_type_ja: ランダム化比較試験（CREDENCE試験）の事後解析
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：血清クレアチニン値の2倍化、腎不全、または心血管疾患または腎疾患による死亡の複合エンドポイント。その他：安全性アウトカム、治療中止、全原因入院、心不全入院または心血管死亡。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 参加者4401名中、非ポリファーマシー612名（14%）、ポリファーマシー2404名（55%）、ハイパーポリファーマシー1385名（31%）。平均薬剤数は8.3（SD 3.77）。安全性アウトカムで相互作用は認められず（全P-interaction > 0.06）。治療中止のP-interaction = 0.16。全原因入院および心不全入院または心血管死亡の発生率は薬剤負荷の増加に伴い増加し、ポリファーマシーおよびハイパーポリファーマシーの患者で絶対的リスク低減がより大きいと推定された。

items.title: SGLT2 inhibitor ameliorates hypertension by regulating the CYP4A/20-HETE pathway in the kidney.
items.abstract: Sodium-Glucose Transport Protein 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i), initially developed as antidiabetic agents and now established as foundational therapies for heart failure, have also shown antihypertensive effects in clinical trials involving patients with diabetes and heart failure. However, the underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Given the diverse roles of arachidonic acid (AA) and its metabolites in blood pressure regulation, we investigated the antihypertensive effects of SGLT2i in hypertensive patients and an animal model, and explored whether modulation of AA metabolism contributes to these effects. We first confirmed the antihypertensive effects of SGLT2i in a retrospective cohort study and spontaneously hypertensive rats (SHRs). Targeted metabolomic analysis of plasma and tissues from SHRs identified 20-hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acid (20-HETE) originating from the renal cortex as a key metabolite modulated by SGLT2i. Among the enzymes responsible for 20-HETE production, CYP4A but not CYP4F was found to be downregulated by dapagliflozin at both mRNA and protein levels. Immunofluorescence colocalization further localized this effect to proximal tubular epithelial cells, where SGLT2i reduced CYP4A expression and subsequent 20-HETE production, leading to attenuated renal inflammation, fibrosis and blood pressure elevation. Together, these findings not only confirm the antihypertensive effects of SGLT2i but also delineate a novel antihypertensive mechanism by which lower blood pressure, demonstrating that modulation of arachidonic acid metabolism contributes partially to blood pressure-lowering effects.
items.authors: Zhou Zhitong, Hang Weijian, Zhao Rui, Jiang Jiangang, Wu Junfang, Wang Dao Wen
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）の降圧作用の機序を解明するため、後ろ向きコホート研究と自己高血圧ラット（SHR）を用いて検討した。標的メタボローム解析により、腎皮質由来の20-HETEがSGLT2iにより調節される主要代謝物として同定された。ダパグリフロジンによりCYP4A（CYP4Fではない）がmRNAおよびタンパク質レベルで低下し、近位尿細管上皮細胞に局在することが免疫蛍光共局在により確認された。これにより20-HETE産生が減少し、腎炎症・線維化・血圧上昇が軽減された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は腎近位尿細管上皮細胞におけるCYP4Aの発現を低下させ、20-HETE産生を抑制することで降圧作用を発揮する新たな機序が示された。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の降圧作用は臨床試験で確認されているが、その機序は十分に解明されていなかった。本研究はアラキドン酸代謝（CYP4A/20-HETE経路）の調節が降圧効果に部分的に寄与することを示し、SGLT2阻害薬の降圧作用の新たな機序を明らかにした。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向きコホート研究および動物実験（自己高血圧ラット）による機序解明研究
items.endpoints_ja: 血圧、20-HETE濃度、CYP4A発現（mRNAおよびタンパク質レベル）、腎炎症、腎線維化

items.title: Adjunctive Treatments for Patients with Type 1 Diabetes Using Automated Insulin Delivery Systems. A Narrative Review.
items.abstract: Automated Insulin Delivery (AID) systems represent the most effective and safe treatment for the management of type 1 diabetes (T1D). Antidiabetic agents used for the treatment of type 2 diabetes, such as the Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 (GLP-1) Receptor Agonists (RAs), the dual Glucose-dependent Insulinotropic Polypeptide and GLP-1 RA and the Sodium-Glucose co-Transporter 2 inhibitors are associated with clinically significant weight loss and cardioprotective effect. Given the increased prevalence of overweight, obesity, and cardiovascular risk in patients with T1D, the addition of these medications to AID treatment is of considerable clinical interest. In this review limited data from randomized controlled and observational trials show that in overweight and obese patients with T1D treated with AID, the addition of weekly semaglutide, or tirzepatide is associated with significant weight loss, reduction in total daily insulin dose and increase in Time In target Range (TIR) without increased risk for hypoglycemia and Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA). Similarly, adjunctive treatment with empagliflozin resulted in increased TIR without increase in hypoglycemia, reduction in insulin requirements, and increase in the mean plasma ketone value, although DKA remained rare. However, studies of longer duration with more participants are required to establish the long-term safety and efficacy of these interventions in patients with T1D treated with AID.
items.authors: Kitsios Konstantinos, Trakatelli Christina-Maria
items.summary_ja: 本論文は、1型糖尿病（T1D）患者における自動インスリン投与（AID）システムへの併用療法（GLP-1受容体作動薬、GIP/GLP-1二重受容体作動薬、SGLT2阻害薬）に関する叙述的レビューである。肥満・過体重のT1D患者においてAIDに併用した週1回セマグルチド、チルゼパチド、エンパグリフロジンの有効性と安全性を、ランダム化比較試験および観察研究の限られたデータから検討した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満・過体重のT1D患者においてAIDにセマグルチド、チルゼパチド、またはエンパグリフロジンを併用すると、体重減少、総日量インスリン用量の減少、TIR（目標範囲内時間）の増加が認められ、低血糖やDKAのリスク増加は認められなかった。ただし、長期の安全性と有効性を確立するためには、より長期かつ大規模な研究が必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: T1D患者において過体重・肥満および心血管リスクの有病率が増加しており、AIDへの併用療法は臨床的に重要な関心事である。
items.study_type_ja: 叙述的レビュー（Narrative Review）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重、総日量インスリン用量、Time In target Range（TIR）、低血糖リスク、糖尿病性ケトアシドーシス（DKA）、平均血漿ケトン値

items.title: Trends in GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Prescriptions for Children Ages 8 to 11 With Obesity: 2019-2026.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Clinical practice guidelines for pediatric obesity management allow for consideration of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) in children ages 8-11. No study has documented secular trends in GLP-1RA prescribing in this group. We hypothesized that there would be a significant increase over time, particularly for children with more severe obesity, greater comorbidity burden, and less socioeconomic vulnerability.
METHODS: This retrospective cross-sectional study of repeated annual cohorts from Epic Cosmos examined GLP-1RA prescriptions (Saxenda, Wegovy, Zepbound) for children (aged 8-11) without diabetes and with obesity from January 1, 2019 to June 17, 2026. A binomial logistic regression model for grouped data was performed to determine whether changes in the proportion of patients prescribed GLP-1RA over time were statistically significant.
RESULTS: Among 3 520 531 children with obesity but without diabetes, 0.6% received a GLP-1RA prescription. Older children (11 years: 79.5/10 000 vs 8 years: 41.5/10 000), female children (75.9/10 000 vs 42.8/10 000), and children with less social vulnerability (low: 76.1/10 000 vs high: 49.2/10 000) were more likely to be prescribed GLP-1RAs. Children with obesity-related comorbidities were substantially more likely to be prescribed GLP-1RAs (188.9/10 000). Prevalent prescribing increased from 0.03% in 2019 to 9.3% in 2026, a 310-fold increase (P < .001).
CONCLUSIONS: In this cohort of >3.5 million children aged 8 to 11 with obesity and without diabetes, GLP-1RA prescribing increased sharply from 2019 to 2026 yet remained uncommon, reaching 0.6% of children. Clinicians appear to be reserving GLP-1RAs for those at greatest cardiometabolic risk. Prescriptions are more likely to go to those with less socioeconomic vulnerability.
items.authors: Orandi Babak J, Patel Suhani S, Messito Mary Jo, Mankowski Michal A, Segev Dorry L, Massie Allan B
items.summary_ja: Epic Cosmosデータベースを用いた後方視的横断研究（反復年次コホート）であり、2019年1月1日から2026年6月17日までの期間において、糖尿病を伴わない肥満を有する8〜11歳小児におけるGLP-1受容体作動薬（Saxenda、Wegovy、Zepbound）の処方傾向を評価した。3,520,531名の対象小児のうち0.6%がGLP-1RA処方を受けた。年齢が大きい（11歳：79.5/10,000 vs 8歳：41.5/10,000）、女性（75.9/10,000 vs 42.8/10,000）、社会的脆弱性が低い（低：76.1/10,000 vs 高：49.2/10,000）、肥満関連合併症を有する（188.9/10,000）小児で処方率が有意に高かった。有病率ベースの処方率は2019年の0.03%から2026年の9.3%へ310倍に増加した（P < .001）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 8〜11歳肥満小児におけるGLP-1RA処方は2019年から2026年にかけて310倍に急増したが、全体では依然として0.6%と低く、臨床医は最も心代謝リスクの高い患者に限定して処方している傾向がある。また、社会的脆弱性が低い小児に処方されやすいという格差が認められた。
items.why_matters_ja: 8〜11歳小児におけるGLP-1RA処方の時間的トレンドを初めて文書化した研究であり、急速な普及の一方で依然として低率にとどまる現状、および社会的脆弱性に基づく処方格差の存在を明らかにした点で、小児肥満管理の臨床実践と公平性の観点から重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的横断研究（反復年次コホート）
items.endpoints_ja: 糖尿病を伴わない肥満を有する8〜11歳小児におけるGLP-1RA処方の有病率（時間的変化）

items.title: Dapagliflozin Ameliorates Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension-Induced Right Heart Failure via Ketone Body Metabolism and Mitochondrial Function Enhancement.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH)-induced right ventricular (RV) failure increases reliance on ketones. The efficacy of SGLT2 inhibitors, known to modulate ketone metabolism, in this context remains unclear.
METHODS: A PAH model was established in Sprague-Dawley rats via a single intraperitoneal injection of monocrotaline (MCT), followed by daily oral administration of dapagliflozin (DAPA). Pulmonary hemodynamics and RV function were evaluated using echocardiography and right heart catheterization. Myocardial injury, fibrosis, and mitochondrial ultrastructure were assessed via histological staining and transmission electron microscopy (TEM). Ketone body levels and metabolic enzyme expression were determined by ELISA and immunoblotting, with transcriptomic analysis identifying potential targets validated by rescue experiments.
RESULTS: DAPA reduced pulmonary arterial pressure, improved RV systolic function, and attenuated RV hypertrophy and fibrosis. These benefits were associated with elevated β-hydroxybutyrate (β-OHB) and acetoacetate levels, alongside the upregulation of key ketone metabolic enzymes, including 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA synthase 2 (HMGCS2), β-hydroxybutyrate dehydrogenase 1 (BDH1), and succinyl-CoA:3-oxoacid CoA transferase (SCOT). Furthermore, DAPA restored mitochondrial homeostasis by increasing adenosine triphosphate (ATP) production, reducing oxidative stress, and shifting mitochondrial dynamics towards fusion-specifically by increasing mitofusin 1 (MFN1) and mitofusin 2 (MFN2), while decreasing dynamin-related protein 1 (DRP1) and fission 1 (FIS1). Transcriptomics revealed significant ADAMTS8 downregulation following DAPA treatment; crucially, adenovirus-mediated ADAMTS8 overexpression partially abrogated these cardioprotective effects.
CONCLUSION: DAPA effectively alleviates PAH-induced right heart failure by suppressing ADAMTS8 expression, thereby enhancing myocardial ketone body metabolism and improving mitochondrial function. These findings identify ADAMTS8 as a key therapeutic target and provide novel evidence supporting the application of DAPA in PAH.
items.authors: Xu Wendong, Liu Jia, Yan Longlong, Er Lu, Tian Shuwei, Du Rongpin
items.summary_ja: 肺動脈性肺高血圧（PAH）による右心不全において、SGLT2阻害薬ダパグリフロジン（DAPA）がケトン体代謝とミトコンドリア機能の改善を介して右心不全を軽減するかどうかを、モノクロタリン（MCT）投与によるラットPAHモデルを用いて検討した前臨床研究。DAPAは肺動脈圧を低下させ、右室収縮機能の改善、右室肥大・線維化の軽減をもたらした。これらの効果はβ-ヒドロキシブチレート（β-OHB）およびアセトアセテートの上昇、HMGCS2・BDH1・SCOTの発現上昇、ATP産生の増加、酸化ストレスの軽減、ミトコンドリア融合の促進（MFN1/MFN2増加、DRP1/FIS1減少）と関連していた。トランスクリプトミクス解析によりADAMTS8の発現低下が同定され、ADAMTS8の過剰発現により心保護効果が部分的に消失した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: DAPAはADAMTS8の発現抑制を介して心筋のケトン体代謝を促進し、ミトコンドリア機能を改善することでPAH誘発右心不全を軽減する。
items.why_matters_ja: PAHによる右心不全は予後不良であり、SGLT2阻害薬のPAHにおける有効性は未解明であった。本研究はDAPAがケトン体代謝とミトコンドリア機能の改善を介して右心不全を軽減する新たな機序を示し、ADAMTS8を治療標的として特定した。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床研究（動物実験）
items.endpoints_ja: 肺動脈圧、右室収縮機能（エコー心図法）、右室肥大、右室線維化、心筋障害、ケトン体レベル（β-OHB、アセトアセテート）、ケトン体代謝酵素発現（HMGCS2、BDH1、SCOT）、ATP産生、酸化ストレス、ミトコンドリア動態（MFN1、MFN2、DRP1、FIS1）、ADAMTS8発現

items.title: Glucagon-like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonist-Associated Injection Site and Dermatologic Reactions.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) are increasingly prescribed for type 2 diabetes mellitus and obesity, with expanding therapeutic applications. Although gastrointestinal adverse events are the most recognized toxicities, Cutaneous adverse events constitute a large burden of total adverse reactions.
OBJECTIVE: To review the prevalence, clinical features, mechanisms, and management of non-immunologic Injection Site and Dermatologic Reactions associated with GLP-1RAs.
METHODS: A review of clinical trials, pharmacovigilance studies, and case reports and series was performed. In addition, adverse event reports for tirzepatide, semaglutide, liraglutide, exenatide, dulaglutide, and lixisenatide were extracted from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS). Injection-site events were combined with skin-related adverse events to generate an adjusted "Skin and Injection-Site Reactions" category for comparison across agents.
RESULTS: Among 442,567 FAERS reports, 137,412 (31.0%) involved skin and injection-site reactions, representing the third most frequently reported adverse event category. Exenatide demonstrated the highest proportion of skin and injection-site reports (53.1%), followed by dulaglutide (33.5%), tirzepatide (32.6%), liraglutide (17.1%), semaglutide (12.2%), and lixisenatide (6.9%). Common reactions included pain, bleeding, erythema, bruising, mass, pruritus, and swelling. Additional adverse events included dysesthesias, nodules, granulomatous reactions, bruising, and hyperhidrosis. Most reactions were mild to moderate and generally managed symptomatically without requiring treatment discontinuation.
CONCLUSIONS: Non-immunologic cutaneous adverse events comprise a substantial proportion of reported GLP-1RA-associated adverse events with differing rates among individual agents. Recognition of these reactions and appropriate supportive management may improve patient outcomes. Prospective studies are needed to better define their adverse event risk rates, mechanisms, and optimal management strategies.
items.authors: Elgindi Dareen, Petronic-Rosic Vesna
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）に関連する非免疫性の注射部位反応および皮膚反応の有病率、臨床的特徴、機序、管理について、臨床試験、薬物警戒研究、症例報告・シリーズをレビューし、さらにFAERSからtirzepatide、semaglutide、liraglutide、exenatide、dulaglutide、lixisenatideの有害事象報告を抽出して比較した。442,567件のFAERS報告のうち137,412件（31.0%）が皮膚および注射部位反応を含み、第3位の有害事象カテゴリーであった。薬剤間で報告割合に差があり、exenatideが最も高かった（53.1%）。多くの反応は軽〜中等度で、対症療法により治療継続が可能であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1RA関連の非免疫性皮膚有害事象は報告された有害事象の大きな割合を占め、薬剤間で発生率に差がある。認識と適切な対症療法により患者アウトカムの改善が期待される。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1RAは2型糖尿病や肥満に対する処方が増加しており、治療応用も拡大している。消化管有害事象が最も認識されている毒性である一方、皮膚有害事象は総有害反応の大きな負担を占めており、臨床現場での認識と管理が患者アウトカムに直結する。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（臨床試験・薬物警戒研究・症例報告の文献レビューおよびFAERSデータベース解析）
items.endpoints_ja: 皮膚および注射部位反応（Skin and Injection-Site Reactions）のFAERS報告における割合（薬剤間比較）

items.title: Beyond Weight Loss: Disentangling the Direct Effects of Semaglutide vs Equivalent Calorie Restriction on Reproductive Systems of Male and Female Rats.
items.abstract: Semaglutide (SEMA), a glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogue approved for treatment of obesity, is now one of the most used anti-obesity pharmacotherapeutic agents worldwide. The effects of SEMA on body weight, appetite, and adiposity are well established. Moreover, sex differences in these effects are clearly emerging. Metabolism and reproduction are intimately intertwined; yet, whether and how these blockbuster drugs affect the reproductive system of males and females is poorly understood. To address this gap, we investigated the impact of chronic SEMA treatment on gonads and circulating reproductive hormones in diet-induced obese male and female rats. GLP-1 receptor is expressed in ovaries and testes, potentially allowing a direct effect of SEMA. Testicular expression of this receptor was 4-fold higher than in ovaries, supporting a potential male bias for potency of the drug effect. To disambiguate the direct effect of the drug from potential downstream effects of weight loss, and ensuing improvements in metabolism produced by the drug, we also evaluated pair-fed (PF) controls. After 4 weeks of treatment, PF and SEMA males displayed improvements in reproductive measures like sperm motility and mucus penetration parameters. Morphological analysis of male and female gonads largely suggested increased fertility. In males, changes in germinal epithelium and seminiferous tubules were detected. In females, increased folliculogenesis was identified in both SEMA and PF rats. Structural changes in the gonads were accompanied by changes in circulating gonadal hormones in a sex-specific manner. In males, SEMA attenuated the weight-loss-induced reduction in all androgens measured. In females, levels of progesterone, pregnenolone, and estradiol were reduced in a treatment specific manner. Pituitary hormones were also affected in both sexes. Altogether, this study highlights broad SEMA-specific, as well as weight loss induced but rescued by SEMA, effects at transcriptional, functional, and systemic levels on the reproductive systems of males and females.
items.authors: Sotzen Morgan R, Byun Suyeun, Ibadin Ngozi O, Knappenberger Mya A, Bento Madison T, Asker Mohammed, Koshkin Sergei, Diaz Francisco J
items.summary_ja: 食事誘発性肥満の雄性・雌性ラットにおいて、慢性セマグルチド（SEMA）投与が性腺および循環性生殖ホルモンに与える影響を調査した。体重減少による下流効果と薬剤の直接効果を分離するため、ペアフィード（PF）対照群も併用した。4週間の投与後、PF群およびSEMA群の雄性ラットでは精子運動性や粘液穿透パラメータなどの生殖指標が改善し、雄性・雌性両方の性腺の形態解析から受精能の増加が示唆された。雄性では生殖上皮と精細管の変化、雌性ではSEMA群およびPF群双方で卵胞発生の増加が認められた。性腺の構造的変化に伴い、循環性性腺ホルモンが性特異的に変化し、雄性ではSEMAが体重減少に伴うすべてのアンドロゲン低下を軽減し、雌性ではプロゲステロン、プレグネノロン、エストラジオールが治療特異的に低下した。下垂体ホルモンも両性で影響を受けた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチドは体重減少効果とは独立した性特異的な直接効果と、体重減少に伴うがSEMAにより救済される効果を、転写・機能・全身レベルで生殖系に及ぼす。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体は卵巣と精巣に発現しており、セマグルチドが性腺に直接作用する可能性を示唆する。セマグルチドは現在世界で最も使用される抗肥満薬の一つであるが、雄性・雌性の生殖系への影響は十分に理解されていない。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床動物実験（食事誘発性肥満ラット、ペアフィード対照群を含む介入試験）
items.endpoints_ja: 精子運動性、粘液穿透パラメータ、雄性・雌性性腺の形態解析（生殖上皮・精細管の変化、卵胞発生）、循環性性腺ホルモン（雄性：アンドロゲン、雌性：プロゲステロン・プレグネノロン・エストラジオール）、下垂体ホルモン
items.endpoint_results_ja: 精巣におけるGLP-1受容体発現は卵巣の4倍であった。4週間投与後、PF群およびSEMA群の雄性ラットで精子運動性と粘液穿透パラメータが改善。雄性・雌性の性腺形態解析から受精能の増加が示唆された。雄性では生殖上皮と精細管の変化が検出された。雌性ではSEMA群およびPF群双方で卵胞発生の増加が認められた。雄性ではSEMAが体重減少に伴うすべての測定されたアンドロゲンの低下を軽減した。雌性ではプロゲステロン、プレグネノロン、エストラジオールが治療特異的に低下した。

items.title: (Un)intended consequences of mass-prescribing GLP-1s.
items.abstract: It is difficult to overstate how much glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) pharmacotherapies have inundated the public discourse on obesity. An avalanche of scientific papers, news articles, and social media posts debate the efficacy, affordability, and appropriateness of GLP-1 receptor agonists not just for obesity but also skin disease, erectile dysfunction, pregnancy, and addiction. Attempting to cut through the noise, the World Health Organization (WHO) recently published the first-ever global guidelines recommending GLP-1s for the treatment of obesity, while committing to develop a global framework ensuring "fair access" to these medicines for the 1 billion people affected worldwide. Going deeper, the guidelines also advocate for "robust populationlevel policies" to address the root causes of obesity in unhealthy food environments. However, to complicate these efforts, WHO's recommendations unfold at a time rife with competitive pressures among pharmaceutical companies, food companies vying for the GLP-1 market segment, and wellness companies promoting supplements and telemedicine programs for what is being billed as a GLP-1 lifestyle. This commercial milieu is ripe for unintended consequences that conspire against fair access to these medicines.
items.authors: Hagenaars Luc L, Schmidt Laura A
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬は肥満に関する公衆の議論を席巻しており、WHOは初めて肥満治療におけるGLP-1の推奨を含むグローバルガイドラインを発表した。同ガイドラインは世界中の10億人の患者への「公平なアクセス」を確保するグローバルフレームワークの構築を約束するとともに、不健全な食品環境における肥満の根本原因に対処する「強固な人口レベルの政策」を提唱している。しかし、製薬企業、食品企業、ウェルネス企業間の競争圧力が高まる中、これらの医薬品への公平なアクセスに逆行する意図しない結果が生じる可能性がある。
items.key_takeaway_ja: WHOのGLP-1推奨は公平なアクセスを目的としているが、製薬・食品・ウェルネス業界の商業的競争環境が、その目的に逆行する意図しない結果を招くリスクがある。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬の大量処方と商業化が加速する中、公平なアクセスを確保するための政策設計が重要な課題となる。
items.study_type_ja: Editorial（論説）
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: Predictive Value of Urine Tubular Biomarkers on Kidney Outcomes: Observations from EMPA-KIDNEY.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Urine tubular biomarkers have previously been associated with chronic kidney disease (CKD) progression independently of estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) and albuminuria. We evaluated whether nine urine tubular biomarkers could improve prediction of kidney failure beyond serum creatinine and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio among adults with CKD.
METHODS: Among 5100 participants in EMPA-KIDNEY, a randomized trial which assessed the effects of empagliflozin 10 mg versus matching placebo among patients with CKD at risk of progression, nine urine creatinine-indexed tubular biomarkers were measured including alpha-1 microglobulin, dickkopf-3, epidermal growth factor [EGF], interleukin-18, kidney injury molecule-1 [KIM-1], monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 [MCP-1], neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin, uromodulin, and human cartilage glycoprotein-40. Outcomes were kidney disease progression ('treated kidney failure', renal death, or sustained ≥40% eGFR decline) and treated kidney failure (maintenance dialysis or kidney transplant). Relative to models based on the linear predictor of the kidney failure risk equation (KFRE), improvements in discrimination were estimated with further addition of the nine tubular biomarkers using absolute difference in Uno's C-index.
RESULTS: Over median 3.5 years of follow-up, 1191 participants experienced kidney disease progression and 461 experienced treated kidney failure. KFRE demonstrated excellent discrimination for treated kidney failure [C-index 0.858 (0.840,0.874)] and moderate discrimination for kidney disease progression [0.724 (0.705,0.743)]. Addition of three biomarkers (MCP-1, KIM-1, and EGF) most strongly associated with CKD outcomes yielded some further improvement in predicting kidney failure [absolute difference 0.014 (0.009,0.024)] and kidney disease progression [0.038 (0.026,0.053)]. Prediction of kidney outcomes were only slightly improved when further expanding from three to all ning tubular biomarkers.
CONCLUSION: In a wide range of causes of CKD, adding three urine tubular biomarkers (MCP-1, KIM-1, EGF) to KFRE improves estimates of risk of CKD progression.
items.journal: Clinical journal of the American Society of Nephrology : CJASN
items.authors: Malijan Greco B, Herrington William G, Judge Parminder K, Sardell Rebecca J, Chapman Daniel, Hill Michael, Moffat Stewart, Zhu Doreen
items.summary_ja: EMPA-KIDNEY試験（empagliflozin 10 mg vs. プラセボ、CKD進行リスクのある成人）の5100名の参加者において、9種の尿クレアチニン指数化細管バイオマーカー（α-1ミクログロブリン、dickkopf-3、EGF、IL-18、KIM-1、MCP-1、NGAL、ウロモジュリン、hCG-40）が、血清クレアチニンと尿アルブミン/クレアチニン比に基づくKFREに追加された際に腎不全の予測を改善するかを評価した。中央値3.5年の追跡期間中、1191名が腎疾患進行、461名が治療腎不全を経験した。KFREは治療腎不全に対してC-index 0.858（0.840, 0.874）、腎疾患進行に対してC-index 0.724（0.705, 0.743）を示した。CKD転帰と最も関連が強い3バイオマーカー（MCP-1、KIM-1、EGF）の追加により、腎不全の予測が絶対差0.014（0.009, 0.024）、腎疾患進行の予測が絶対差0.038（0.026, 0.053）改善された。3種から全9種に拡大しても予測改善はわずかに留まった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: KFREにMCP-1、KIM-1、EGFの3種の尿細管バイオマーカーを追加することで、CKD進行のリスク推定が改善される。
items.why_matters_ja: CKD患者の腎不全リスク予測において、既存のKFREに尿細管バイオマーカーを追加することで予測精度が向上する可能性が示された。これは臨床試験におけるリスク層別化や患者選定、また個別化されたリスク評価に活用できる可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: ランダム化比較試験（EMPA-KIDNEY）の二次解析
items.endpoints_ja: 1) 腎疾患進行（治療腎不全、腎死、または持続的なeGFR 40%以上の低下）2) 治療腎不全（維持透析または腎移植）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 中央値3.5年の追跡期間中、腎疾患進行1191名、治療腎不全461名。KFREのC-index：治療腎不全 0.858（0.840, 0.874）、腎疾患進行 0.724（0.705, 0.743）。MCP-1、KIM-1、EGF追加によるUno's C-indexの絶対差：腎不全 0.014（0.009, 0.024）、腎疾患進行 0.038（0.026, 0.053）。

items.title: From insulin resistance to incretin receptor agonism in the prevention of type 2 diabetes mellitus in obese individuals.
items.abstract: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) represents one of the most significant metabolic challenges of the modern era, with more than 828 million people worldwide living with diabetes. Obesity and insulin resistance are major modifiable contributors to T2DM risk and progression, although the disease is heterogeneous and arises from complex interactions among β-cell dysfunction, hepatic glucose dysregulation, adipose-tissue dysfunction, altered incretin biology, chronic low-grade inflammation, and genetic susceptibility. In individuals with obesity and insulin resistance, progression through prediabetes to overt hyperglycaemia represents an important, although not universal, disease trajectory and provides a clinically relevant window for preventive intervention. This review examines pharmacological strategies relevant to T2DM prevention in individuals without established diabetes who have prediabetes and/or obesity associated with a high risk of progression to T2DM, with particular emphasis on incretin-based obesity pharmacotherapy. Metformin remains the glucose-lowering agent with the most established long-term evidence for diabetes prevention in selected high-risk individuals with prediabetes, acting through multiple hepatic and intestinal mechanisms involving both AMPK-dependent and AMPK-independent pathways. Other established antihyperglycaemic drug classes are discussed primarily to distinguish therapies with evidence for delaying progression to diabetes from agents whose principal role remains the treatment of established T2DM. SGLT2 inhibitors provide substantial cardiovascular and renal protection, although current evidence is insufficient to support their routine use solely for T2DM prevention. GLP-1 receptor agonists and the dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist tirzepatide have substantially advanced obesity pharmacotherapy, producing clinically meaningful weight loss and broader cardiometabolic benefits that may reduce progression to T2DM in high-risk individuals.Next-generation incretin-based therapies, including triple receptor agonists, may further expand therapeutic options but remain an evolving area of investigation. Lifestyle intervention and sustained weight management remain the foundation of T2DM prevention, with pharmacological strategies selected according to individual metabolic risk, obesity-related treatment indications, comorbidities, and the strength of evidence supporting diabetes prevention.
items.authors: Teofilović Branislava, Trkulja Jelena, Grujić-Letić Nevena, Gligorić Emilia, Baletic Djordje, Tomić Ljiljana, Mesarović Aleksandra, Rašković Aleksandar
items.summary_ja: 肥満およびインスリン抵抗性を有する2型糖尿病（T2DM）未罹患者におけるT2DM予防の薬物戦略をレビューした。メトホルミンは前糖尿病を有する高リスク個体における糖尿病予防に最も確立された長期エビデンスを持つ血糖降下薬であり、AMPK依存性及び非依存性の肝・腸管機構を介して作用する。SGLT2阻害薬は心血管・腎保護効果は大きいものの、T2DM予防単独の適応としての現在のエビデンスは不十分である。GLP-1受容体作動薬およびGIP/GLP-1二重受容体作動薬tirzepatideは肥満薬物療法を大きく前進させ、臨床的に有意な減量と広範な心代謝保護効果により、高リスク個体におけるT2DMへの進行抑制に寄与し得る。次世代インクレチン系療法（三重受容体作動薬等）は治療選択肢をさらに拡大し得るが、依然として研究段階である。生活習慣介入と持続的な体重管理がT2DM予防の基盤であり、薬物戦略は個々の代謝リスク、肥満関連治療適応、合併症、および糖尿病予防を支持するエビデンスの強さに応じて選択される。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満・インスリン抵抗性を有する前糖尿病個体におけるT2DM予防において、メトホルミンが最も確立されたエビデンスを持つ一方、GLP-1受容体作動薬やtirzepatideといったインクレチン系薬物療法が肥満治療の進展を通じて糖尿病予防に新たな選択肢を提供しつつある。
items.why_matters_ja: 世界中で8億2,800万人以上が糖尿病を有し、肥満とインスリン抵抗性はT2DMリスクの主要な修正可能因子である。前糖尿病から顕性高血糖への進行は予防介入の臨床的に重要な窓を提供するため、肥満個体におけるT2DM予防の薬物戦略の整理は公衆衛生上重要である。

items.title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists for Obstructive Sleep Apnea: A Review.
items.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) affects nearly 1 billion adults worldwide and is independently associated with cardiovascular disease, stroke, and increased mortality. While continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) remains the criterion standard treatment, adherence rates of only 30% to 60% limit its population-level effectiveness. Obesity is present in 60% to 70% of patients with OSA and represents the primary modifiable risk factor, yet, until recently, no pharmacological therapies specifically targeted this pathophysiological mechanism. The December 2024 US Food and Drug Administration approval of tirzepatide as the first medication indicated for moderate to severe OSA in adults with obesity represents a paradigm shift toward disease-modifying pharmacotherapy, with implications for otolaryngologic practice.
OBSERVATIONS: Six meta-analyses demonstrated consistent apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) reductions with glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs), ranging from -5.7 to -21.9 events per hour. The SURMOUNT-OSA phase 3 trials showed that tirzepatide reduced AHI by 20 to 24 events per hour vs placebo, with 42% to 50% of patients experiencing disease remission (AHI, <5 events per hour or <15 without symptoms). Weight loss is the primary established mechanism, with GLP-1 RAs reducing tongue fat and parapharyngeal adipose tissue that contribute to upper airway collapse. Emerging preclinical evidence has suggested potential weight-independent effects through carotid body glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor modulation of chemosensitivity (affecting loop gain), leptin pathway interactions that are associated with upper airway neuromuscular control, and NLRP3 inflammasome suppression. However, GLP-1 RAs did not match CPAP efficacy (approximately22 vs 31 events per hour of an AHI reduction), cardiovascular outcome benefits remain unproven, and weight regain commonly occurs after discontinuation.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: This review suggest that GLP-1 RAs offer otolaryngologists a disease-modifying adjunct for obesity-related OSA that is best positioned as complementary therapy alongside CPAP, preoperative optimization before upper airway surgery, or potentially to expand hypoglossal nerve stimulator candidacy. They are appropriate for patients with a body mass index (calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared) greater than 30 who are CPAP-intolerant or have obesity-related comorbidities but are unlikely to benefit individuals without obesity or those with primarily anatomical obstruction. Critical evidence gaps include associations with pharyngeal critical closing pressure, drug-induced sleep endoscopy collapse patterns, and hypoglossal nerve stimulator combination therapy outcomes.
items.authors: Harris Alexandria, Kaffenberger Thomas
items.summary_ja: 本レビューは、肥満を伴う閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸（OSA）に対するグルカゴン様ペプチド-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）の役割を考察する。2024年12月にFDAがtirzepatideを肥満を伴う中等症〜重症OSAの適応として承認したことを背景に、6つのメタアナリシスによるAHI減少効果、SURMOUNT-OSA第III相試験の結果、体重減少を主とする作用機序（舌脂肪・傍咽頭脂肪組織の減少）、および体重非依存性機序（頸動体GLP-1受容体による化学感受性調節、レプチン経路、NLRP3炎症小体抑制）を概観する。耳鼻咽喉科臨床における位置づけとして、CPAP併用療法、上気道手術前の最適化、下舌神経刺激器適応拡大の可能性を提示する。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1 RAは肥満関連OSAに対する疾患修飾的補助療法として、CPAP併用、上気道手術前の最適化、下舌神経刺激器適応拡大の拡大に最も適した位置づけである。BMI>30でCPAP不耐容または肥満関連合併症を有する患者に適切だが、肥満を伴わない患者や主に解剖学的閉塞を有する患者には効果は期待できない。
items.why_matters_ja: OSAは世界で約10億人の成人に影響し、心血管疾患・脳卒中・死亡率上昇と独立に関連する。標準治療であるCPAPのアドヒアランスは30〜60%にとどまり、OSA患者の60〜70%に肥満が存在するにもかかわらず、これまでこの病態生理学的メカニズムに特化した薬物療法は存在しなかった。tirzepatideのFDA承認は疾患修飾的薬物療法へのパラダイムシフトを意味し、耳鼻咽喉科臨床に直接的な影響を与える。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 呼吸時無呼吸低呼吸指数（AHI）の減少、疾患寛解（AHI<5 events/hour または 無症状で<15 events/hour）

items.title: Emerging Topics In Obesity Treatment in the Setting of Organ Transplantation.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: This review summarizes current evidence on the treatment of obesity in the solid organ transplant setting and identifies evidence gaps.
RECENT FINDINGS: Lifestyle modification, pharmacotherapy, and metabolic and bariatric surgery are all potential options for management of obesity in the setting of solid organ transplantation. Limited available data on use of incretin-based pharmacotherapy in solid organ transplantation support its safety and effectiveness in appropriately-selected patients, however prospective large-scale studies are needed. Obesity treatment is an important component of transplant care, as obesity is associated with increased mortality and adverse graft outcomes. Lifestyle modification, anti-obesity pharmacotherapy, and metabolic and bariatric surgery can be employed safely in both pre- and post-transplant settings. Newer incretin-based pharmacotherapy, including glucagon-like peptide 1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists and dual GLP-1 receptor agonist/gastric inhibitory polypeptide offer potential for substantial weight loss and improved cardiometabolic outcomes. Bariatric and endoscopic metabolic procedures can be beneficial in carefully selected patients pre- or post-transplant. Precision approaches including sarcopenic obesity and measurement of body composition can help tailor interventions. These developments highlight the importance of multidisciplinary management and underscore the need for additional research within transplant populations.
items.authors: Maahs Ethan, Zimmerman Zoe, Khungar Vandana, Banini Bubu A
items.summary_ja: 固形臓器移植における肥満治療の現状証拠を総括し、エビデンスのギャップを特定したレビュー記事。生活習慣改善、薬物療法（インクレチン系薬剤を含む）、代謝・肥満手術が移植前後の肥満管理の選択肢として検討されている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満治療（生活習慣改善、抗肥満薬物療法、代謝・肥満手術）は移植前後のいずれの場面でも安全に実施可能であるが、特にインクレチン系薬物療法については前向き大規模研究が未だ必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満は移植患者において死亡率の増加や移植片の不良転帰と関連しており、肥満治療は移植ケアの重要な構成要素である。

items.title: Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors and gastrointestinal neoplasm risk in type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.abstract: The potential carcinogenic effects of sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) remain controversial, particularly regarding site-specific gastrointestinal (GI) neoplasms. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to determine the relationship between SGLT2 inhibitors and the risk of GI neoplasms in patients with T2DM. We searched PubMed, EMBASE, Cochrane CENTRAL, Scopus, and Web of Science through March 17, 2025, for RCTs in T2DM comparing SGLT2 inhibitors with placebo or active comparators. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed the risk of bias. The primary outcome was GI neoplasms reported in publications, supplementary materials, or trial registries, usually as adverse events rather than centrally adjudicated cancer endpoints. Pooled odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated in Stata 17.0. In 48 RCTs (n = 48,765), SGLT2 inhibitor therapy was not associated with overall GI neoplasm risk (OR = 1.10, 95% CI: 0.84-1.44; p = 0.46; I² = 0%). Site-specific analyses showed no statistically significant association for esophageal (OR = 1.12, 95% CI 0.37-3.45), gastric (1.20, 0.65-2.23), hepatic (0.62, 0.31-1.22), pancreatic (0.91, 0.51-1.64), colonic (1.28, 0.78-2.08), colorectal (0.76, 0.27-2.17), and rectal neoplasms (0.98, 0.49-1.97), with all p-values > 0.05. Subgroup analyses by agents (e.g., canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, empagliflozin), baseline age, body mass index (BMI), HbA1c, treatment duration, and dose were also non-significant (all p > 0.05). Approximately half of the trials had follow-up of one year or less, limiting our ability to evaluate long-term risk. Available RCT evidence does not show a clear increase in GI neoplasm risk with SGLT2 inhibitors in T2DM. However, limited follow-up, low event counts, and non-cancer-specific outcome ascertainment, the findings should be interpreted as reassuring but not definitive evidence of long-term oncologic safety.Systematic review registration: PROSPERO No. CRD42024619019.
items.authors: Zhang Yu-Fan, Xie Jia-Jie, Wu Qi, Zhou Xiao-Yu, Zeng Chen, Zeng Yan, He Yi-Meng, Guo Man
items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者におけるSGLT2阻害薬と消化管腫瘍リスクの関連を評価したランダム化比較試験（RCT）の系統的レビューおよびメタアナリシス。PubMed、EMBASE、Cochrane CENTRAL、Scopus、Web of Scienceを2025年3月17日までに検索し、SGLT2阻害薬をプラセボまたは活性比較薬と比較したT2DMのRCTを対象とした。主要アウトカムは、出版物、補足資料、または試験登録に登録された消化管腫瘍（通常は有害事象として報告され、中央裁定されたがんエンドポイントではない）。48件のRCT（n=48,765）を含むメタアナリシスでは、SGLT2阻害薬の投与は消化管腫瘍全体のリスクと関連しなかった（OR=1.10, 95% CI: 0.84-1.44; p=0.46; I²=0%）。部位別解析では、食道（OR=1.12, 95% CI 0.37-3.45）、胃（1.20, 0.65-2.23）、肝（0.62, 0.31-1.22）、膵（0.91, 0.51-1.64）、結腸（1.28, 0.78-2.08）、大腸（0.76, 0.27-2.17）、直腸腫瘍（0.98, 0.49-1.97）いずれも統計的に有意な関連は認められなかった（全p値>0.05）。薬剤別（カナグリフロジン、ダパグリフロジン、エンパグリフロジン）、ベースライン年齢、BMI、HbA1c、治療期間、用量によるサブグループ解析も有意ではなかった（全p>0.05）。約半数の試験はフォローアップが1年以下であり、長期リスクの評価には限界がある。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 利用可能なRCTのエビデンスでは、T2DM患者においてSGLT2阻害薬による消化管腫瘍リスクの明確な増加は示されていない。ただし、フォローアップ期間の短さ、イベント数の少なさ、がん特異的なアウトカムアセスメントの不在から、本結果は安心材料ではあるが、長期の腫瘍学的安全性を確定するものではない。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の潜在的ながん原性、特に部位特異的な消化管腫瘍に関する議論は未解決であり、本メタアナリシスはSGLT2阻害薬の消化管がんリスクに関する安全性プロファイルの重要なエビデンスを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: ランダム化比較試験の系統的レビューおよびメタアナリシス
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：消化管腫瘍（有害事象として報告）。部位別解析：食道腫瘍、胃腫瘍、肝腫瘍、膵腫瘍、結腸腫瘍、大腸腫瘍、直腸腫瘍。サブグループ解析：薬剤別（カナグリフロジン、ダパグリフロジン、エンパグリフロジン）、ベースライン年齢、BMI、HbA1c、治療期間、用量。

items.title: Pharmacotherapy of heart failure: Impact of the 2021 guideline update on guideline-directed medical therapy assessed using a Japanese employee health insurance claims database.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate the impact of the 2021 guideline update on guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) utilization in patients with heart failure (HF).
BACKGROUND: The 2021 update of the Japanese guidelines for HF management followed the introduction of sacubitril/valsartan and dapagliflozin into clinical practice. However, the impact of this guideline update on drug utilization patterns remains unclear.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Patient data were obtained from the Japanese employee health insurance claims database (JMDC). The simple GDMT score was determined based on the combination and dose of four key pharmacological classes: β-blockers, renin-angiotensin system inhibitors, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists, and sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors. Because a simple GDMT score of ≥ 5 has been associated with improved prognosis in patients with HF, patients with scores ≥ 5 were classified into the high-score group for analysis.
RESULTS: Following the guideline update, the proportion of patients in the high-score group increased from 6.97% (n = 4,013) to 9.33% (n = 6,363), standardized difference 0.09. The mean simple GDMT score also showed a small but statistically significant increase (5.72 ± 0.79 vs. 6.00 ± 1.09) with standardized difference 0.28. This upward trend was particularly marked for the prescription rates of sacubitril/valsartan and dapagliflozin (sacubitril/valsartan: 1.40% before the update vs. 22.57% after the update; standardized difference, 0.69; dapagliflozin: 12.41% before the update vs. 26.64% after the update; standardized difference, 0.36).
CONCLUSION: The 2021 guideline update was associated with increased use of sacubitril/valsartan and dapagliflozin, resulting in greater overall GDMT intensity. However, these findings are limited to data from 2021, and further long-term studies are needed to evaluate trends in GDMT utilization.
