items.summary_ja: 2021年の日本心不全ガイドライン更新がガイドライン推奨薬物療法（GDMT）の利用に与えた影響を、日本の従業員健康保険請求データベース（JMDC）を用いて調査した。β遮断薬、レニン・アンギオテンシン系阻害薬、鉱質コルチコイド受容体拮抗薬、SGLT2阻害薬の4つの主要薬物クラスに基づく簡易GDMTスコアを算出し、スコア≥5を高スコア群として分類した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 2021年のガイドライン更新後、サクビトリル/バルサルタンとダパグリフロジンの処方率が大幅に増加し、GDMT全体の強度（平均簡易GDMTスコア）が有意に向上した。
items.why_matters_ja: ガイドライン更新が実際の臨床現場の薬物利用パターンにどのように影響を与えるかをリアルワールドデータで示すことで、ガイドラインの臨床実装効果を評価する参考となる。
items.study_type_ja: 観察研究（請求データベースを用いた後方視的コホート研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 高スコア群（簡易GDMTスコア≥5）の割合、平均簡易GDMTスコア、サクビトリル/バルサルタンの処方率、ダパグリフロジンの処方率
items.sample_size_ja: 高スコア群の人数は更新前 n=4,013、更新後 n=6,363 と記載されているが、総サンプルサイズ（全患者数）は抄録に記載なし

items.title: Postmarketing Safety Signals and Medication-Use Risks of GLP-1-Based Therapies in Diabetes and Obesity: A Multi-Source Pharmacovigilance and Regulatory Evidence-Mapping Study.
items.abstract:
AIMS: To characterise postmarketing safety signals and medication-use risks associated with GLP-1 receptor agonists and the GIP/GLP-1 co-agonist tirzepatide in diabetes and obesity care using an integrated pharmacovigilance, utilisation-context, regulatory, and external-consistency framework.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) data from 2021Q1 through 2026Q1 were processed using deleted-case exclusion, latest-case-version retention, and case-product deduplication with analysis at the GLP-1 primary-suspect case-product level. Primary-suspect records for semaglutide, tirzepatide, dulaglutide, liraglutide, exenatide, and lixisenatide were analysed using reporting odds ratios, proportional reporting ratios, and an approximate Information Component. Medicaid utilisation data, FDA labelling/Safety-Related Labelling Changes resources, FDA shortage and compounded-product communications, and Canada Vigilance reports provided contextual interpretation; no data source was used to estimate incidence, comparative risk, or causality.
RESULTS: The final FAERS analysis set included 243 114 GLP-1 primary-suspect case-product records within 8 995 547 background reports. Tirzepatide accounted for 133 100 records, followed by semaglutide (55619) and dulaglutide (38406). Frequently reported terms included incorrect dose administered, nausea, injection-site pain, diarrhoea, vomiting, off-label use, and extra dose administered. Prioritised domains included gastrointestinal intolerance, medication-use/device events, impaired gastric emptying, pancreatobiliary events, renal/dehydration events, and hypoglycaemia. Canada Vigilance and FDA labelling/SrLC mapping showed descriptive visibility for most major domains, while medication-use terms reflected use-process rather than conventional adverse-drug-reaction issues.
CONCLUSIONS: Multi-source pharmacovigilance can improve interpretation of GLP-1 postmarketing safety evidence in diabetes and obesity care. Findings should be interpreted as signal-prioritisation and medication-safety evidence, not as incidence, proof of causality, or population-level comparative risk, given the limited clinical interpretability of spontaneous-reporting data.
items.authors: Ren Long, Zhang Yuan, Fang Fang, Ma Yabin
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬およびGIP/GLP-1共作動薬tirzepatideの糖尿病・肥満治療における市販後安全性シグナルと薬剤使用リスクを、統合的な薬物警戒・利用コンテキスト・規制・外部整合性フレームワークを用いて特徴化する研究。FAERSデータ（2021年Q1〜2026年Q1）をdeleted-case exclusion、latest-case-version retention、case-product deduplicationを経て、GLP-1 primary-suspect case-productレベルで分析。ROR、PRR、近似ICを用いたシグナル検出に加え、Medicaid利用データ、FDAラベリング/SrLC、FDA供給不足・調剤品通信、Canada Vigilance報告を文脈的解釈に使用。最終分析セットは8,995,547件の背景報告内に243,114件のGLP-1 primary-suspect case-product記録を含む。
items.key_takeaway_ja: マルチソース薬物警戒は糖尿病・肥満治療におけるGLP-1の市販後安全性証拠の解釈を改善しうるが、自発報告データの臨床的解釈の限界から、結果はシグナル優先順位付けおよび薬剤安全性証拠として解釈すべきであり、発症率、因果関係の証明、集団レベルの比較リスクとしては解釈すべきでない。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1系薬剤は糖尿病・肥満治療で広く使用されており、市販後の安全性シグナルと薬剤使用リスクの把握は患者安全に重要である。本研究は、薬剤使用関連用語（誤った用量の投与、追加用量の投与など）が従来の有害事象（ADR）の問題ではなく使用プロセスの問題を反映していることを示し、薬物警戒データの解釈における重要な区別を提示している。
items.study_type_ja: 市販後薬物警戒研究（FAERS自発報告データを用いたシグナル検出：ROR、PRR、近似IC）および規制証拠マッピング研究。臨床試験ではない。
items.endpoints_ja: GLP-1 primary-suspect case-productレベルでの安全性シグナル検出（ROR、PRR、近似ICによる優先ドメインの特定）。優先ドメイン：消化管不耐性、薬剤使用/デバイス関連事象、胃排出障害、膵胆道事象、腎/脱水事象、低血糖。

items.title: Chronic kidney disease progression with proton pump inhibitors versus H2 receptor antagonists in NSAID users.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Clinical evidence comparing the renal impact of proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) and Histamine-2 receptor antagonists (H2RAs) in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) receiving traditional non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (tNSAIDs) is lacking. We evaluated CKD progression risk associated with PPIs versus H2RAs within a tNSAID-treated cohort to inform clinical prescribing.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study used South Korean nationwide claims data (2018-2023). Stabilized inverse probability of treatment weighting (SIPTW) balanced the cohorts. Restricted cubic spline Cox regression addressed non-linear associations between CKD progression and cumulative exposure to tNSAIDs and acid suppressants (PPIs or H2RAs). Sensitivity analyses addressing unspecified CKD stages confirmed the robustness of the primary findings.
RESULTS: Among 141 093 tNSAID initiators with CKD prescribed PPIs (n = 5315) or H2RAs (n = 7112), PPIs were associated with higher CKD progression risk than H2RAs (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] 1.38, 95% CI 1.10-1.74). Baseline comorbidities-hypertension (aHR 2.03, 95% CI 1.37-2.99]), diabetes (1.69 [1.29-2.21]), and a history of kidney disease (1.43 [1.13-1.81])-and prior diuretic use (2.00 [1.56-2.58]) were associated with increased risk of CKD progression. In contrast, dapagliflozin or empagliflozin use was protective (0.49 [0.27-0.89]). The risk of CKD progression for PPIs relative to H2RAs was most pronounced in females, those with CKD stage 3, patients aged ≥71 years, and those with 1-15 days of treatment (all P < .05).
CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that H2RAs may be associated with a lower risk of CKD progression than PPIs in tNSAID users with CKD, potentially offering a safer alternative when PPI therapy is not indispensable.
items.authors: Park Susin, Chun Pusoon
items.summary_ja: 韓国全国保険請求データ（2018-2023年）を用いた後方視コホート研究であり、tNSAID使用のCKD患者においてPPIとH2RAのCKD進行リスクを比較した。安定化逆確率治療重み付け（SIPTW）と制限的立方スプラインCox回帰を用い、PPIはH2RAと比較してCKD進行リスクが高いことを示した（aHR 1.38, 95% CI 1.10-1.74）。女性、CKDステージ3、71歳以上、治療期間1-15日の患者でリスク差が最も顕著であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: tNSAID使用のCKD患者において、PPIはH2RAと比較してCKD進行リスクが有意に高い（aHR 1.38, 95% CI 1.10-1.74）。PPIが不可欠でない場合、H2RAがより安全な代替選択肢となり得る。
items.why_matters_ja: CKD患者におけるtNSAID併用時の胃酸抑制薬の選択は臨床的に重要な課題であり、本研究はPPIとH2RAの腎影響を直接比較した臨床証拠を提供し、処方判断に資する。特にSGLT2阻害薬（ダパグリフロジン・エンパグリフロジン）の保護効果（aHR 0.49）も示され、CKD管理における薬剤選択の戦略に示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート研究（全国保険請求データ）
items.endpoints_ja: CKD進行（主要エンドポイント）
items.endpoint_results_ja: PPI vs H2RA: aHR 1.38, 95% CI 1.10-1.74。高血圧: aHR 2.03, 95% CI 1.37-2.99。糖尿病: aHR 1.69, 95% CI 1.29-2.21。腎疾患の既往: aHR 1.43, 95% CI 1.13-1.81。利尿薬の既往使用: aHR 2.00, 95% CI 1.56-2.58。ダパグリフロジンまたはエンパグリフロジン使用: aHR 0.49, 95% CI 0.27-0.89。

items.title: Semaglutide Bioavailability: Limitations, Formulation Innovation and Future Opportunities.
items.abstract: Semaglutide, a long-acting glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist, improved the type 2 diabetes mellitus treatment and obesity by its glucose-lowering and weight loss effects. Although the subcutaneous route provides high bioavailability and stable pharmacokinetics, the development of oral semaglutide makes a significant advancement in peptide therapeutics. However, oral delivery remains limited by an absolute bioavailability of only approximately 0.4-1% under optimized fasting conditions with restricted water intake, whereas systemic exposure is essentially absent in the fed state because plasma semaglutide concentrations remain below the limit of quantification. This extremely low exposure reflects peptide degradation within the gastrointestinal tract, poor epithelial permeability, gastric physiological constraints, and presystemic metabolism. The combination with sodium N-(8-[2-hydroxybenzoyl]amino) caprylate (SNAC) helps in gastric absorption by increasing the local gastric microenvironmental pH, thereby reducing acid-induced peptide unfolding, suppressing pepsin activation, maintaining semaglutide predominantly in its absorbable monomeric form by limiting oligomer formation, and enhancing transcellular uptake. But the oral form of semaglutide is constrained by narrow dose limits, considerable pharmacokinetic variability that, despite large fluctuations in individual absorption, produces relatively stable steady-state exposure because semaglutide's approximately one-week half-life and extensive albumin binding buffer day-to-day differences in absorption. This review examines semaglutide pharmacokinetics, focusing on mechanistic challenges to oral bioavailability and formulation approaches to address this. We assess emerging methods such as nanotechnology-based formulations, other permeation enhancers, enzyme inhibitors and device-based delivery systems for their abilities to improve absorption and efficacy. Furthermore, clinical efficacy and patient adherence as well as research opportunities are considered. Continual development of these technologies may emerge as a solution to enhance bioavailability, decrease dosing frequency and expand the range of uses of oral peptide therapies.
items.authors: Vahora Shahin, Shah Vishal, Patel Bhavesh
items.summary_ja: セマグルチドは長作用型GLP-1受容体アゴニストであり、2型糖尿病および肥満の治療に血糖降下作用と減量効果により貢献している。皮下投与は高い生体利用率和安定した薬物動態を提供するが、経口セマグルチドの開発はペプチド治療における重要な進歩である。しかし、経口投与は最適化された絶食条件（水分摂取制限付き）下でも絶対生体利用率が約0.4〜1%と極めて低く、食後状態では血中セマグルチド濃度が定量限界以下であり全身曝露は実質的に欠如している。本レビューは、セマグルチドの薬物動態、経口生体利用率の機能的課題、およびそれに対処する製剤アプローチ（ナノテクノロジーベースの製剤、他の透過促進剤、酵素阻害剤、デバイスベースの送達システム）を考察している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 経口セマグルチドの生体利用率は絶食条件下でも約0.4〜1%と極めて低く、食後状態では全身曝露が実質的に欠如する。SNACの併用により胃内吸収が促進されるが、狭い用量制限と大きな薬物動態変動が課題であり、半減期（約1週間）とアルブミン結合が日内変動を緩衝して比較的安定した定常状態曝露を維持している。
items.why_matters_ja: 経口ペプチド治療の生体利用率向上は、投与頻度の低減と適応範囲の拡大につながる可能性がある。セマグルチドの経口製剤の限界と将来の技術的解決策（ナノテクノロジー、透過促進剤、酵素阻害剤、デバイスベース送達）の理解は、ペプチド医薬品の開発戦略に直接的な示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし（本稿はレビューであり、特定の臨床試験エンドポイントの定義は記載されていない）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 絶対生体利用率：最適化された絶食条件（水分摂取制限付き）下で約0.4〜1%。食後状態：血中セマグルチド濃度が定量限界以下（全身曝露は実質的に欠如）。半減期：約1週間。

items.title: Patulous Eustachian tube dysfunction following rapid weight loss associated with semaglutide use: A case report.
items.abstract: Patulous Eustachian tube dysfunction (PETD) is an uncommon condition characterized by an abnormally patent Eustachian tube, leading to symptoms such as aural fullness and autophony. Rapid weight loss is a recognized risk factor due to loss of peritubal adipose support. With the increasing use of semaglutide and other glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists for obesity management, substantial and rapid weight reduction has become more common, raising the potential for underrecognized otologic complications. A 79-year-old male presented with intermittent bilateral aural fullness and ear "popping" without associated pain, vertigo, or systemic symptoms. His history was notable for intentional weight loss of approximately 200 lb following initiation of semaglutide therapy. Otoscopic examination was unremarkable, and prior tympanometry demonstrated normal middle ear pressure. In the absence of findings suggestive of obstructive Eustachian tube dysfunction, a clinical diagnosis of patulous Eustachian tube dysfunction was made. The patient was managed conservatively with hydration, intranasal saline, and avoidance of decongestants. Rapid, extreme weight loss associated with GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy may precipitate PETD and should be considered in patients presenting with aural fullness and normal middle ear findings. Recognition of this association supports appropriate conservative management and may prevent unnecessary interventions.
items.authors: Burmeister James R, Jawad Malik, Zazay Ismail, Kobernick Aaron
items.summary_ja: セマグルチド治療開始後に約200ポンドの意図的な減量を経た79歳男性が、間欠的な両側性耳閉塞感と耳の「ポッピング」を主訴に来院した。耳鏡所見は異常なく、以前のティンパノメトリーでは中耳圧が正常であった。閉塞性耳管機能障害を思わせる所見がないことから、弛緩性耳管機能障害（PETD）と臨床診断された。水分補給、鼻腔内生理食塩水、去充血薬の回避による保存的治療が行われた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬治療に伴う急速かつ極端な減量はPETDを誘発し得るため、耳閉塞感と正常な中耳所見を呈する患者において本症を考慮すべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: セマグルチドをはじめとするGLP-1受容体作動薬の肥満管理における使用増加に伴い、著明かつ急速な減量が増加しており、未認識の耳科合併症の潜在的可能性が高まっている。本関連の認識は適切な保存的治療を支持し、不要な介入を防止できる可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 単例報告（Case Report）
items.endpoints_ja: 単例報告であり、正式な評価項目（endpoint）は定義されていない。臨床診断（PETD）と保存的治療による管理が記載されている。

items.title: Current therapeutic landscape and future treatment perspectives of MASH.
items.abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), the progressive form of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), is a heterogeneous and systemic disease that confers risk not only for cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) but also for extrahepatic complications including cardiovascular disease and chronic kidney disease. Over the past decade, numerous late-stage clinical trials have advanced the therapeutic landscape of MASH, culminating in a pivotal inflection point with accelerated approval of the thyroid hormone receptor-β (THRβ) agonist resmetirom and the glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor (GLP-1R) agonist semaglutide, establishing pharmacological options for patients with non-cirrhotic MASH and fibrosis. Concurrently, growing evidence indicates that MASH comprises distinct, partially overlapping disease subsets, ranging from liver-centric phenotypes with accelerated fibrogenesis and liver-related outcomes to cardiometabolic phenotypes characterized by insulin resistance and increased cardiovascular risk. This suggests that optimal treatment efficacy will require stratified and potentially combinatorial approaches. In addition to lifestyle interventions, a cornerstone of MASLD management, pharmacotherapies targeting metabolic dysfunction (including PPAR agonists, FGF21 analogues or incretin-based and glucagon-based therapies), fibrogenesis, inflammation and/or the gut-liver axis are emerging. In this Review, we summarize the therapeutic landscape for MASH and discuss how recent advances in disease phenotyping and biomarkers may enable a transition towards personalized therapy.
items.authors: Gallage Suchira, Govaere Olivier, Anstee Quentin M, Shulman Gerald I, Tacke Frank, Heikenwalder Mathias
items.summary_ja: MASH（代謝機能異常関連脂肪性肝炎）の治療の現状と将来の展望を総説したレビュー論文。過去10年間の後期臨床試験の進展を概観し、甲状腺ホルモン受容体β（THRβ）アゴニストのレスメチロームとGLP-1受容体アゴニストのセマグルチドの加速承認を転換点として位置づけている。また、MASHが肝臓中心型と心代謝型という部分的に重複する異なる疾患サブセットから構成されることを示唆し、層別化・併用アプローチの必要性を論じている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: MASHは肝臓中心型（線維化加速・肝関連アウトカム）と心代謝型（インスリン抵抗性・心血管リスク増大）という部分的に重複する異なる疾患サブセットから構成されており、最適な治療効果には層別化および潜在的な併用アプローチが必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: MASHは肝硬変・肝細胞癌だけでなく、心血管疾患や慢性腎臓病などの肝外合併症のリスクも伴う疾患であり、レスメチロームとセマグルチドの加速承認により、非肝硬変性MASHかつ線維化を有する患者に対して薬物治療の選択肢が確立された。
items.study_type_ja: Review
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: From measured BMI to documented obesity in hospitalized adults: a decade-long analysis and implications for cardiometabolic care.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Obesity contributes substantially to cardiometabolic and overall morbidity and mortality, yet remains underdiagnosed in clinical practice. We aimed to assess discharge documentation rates of obesity among hospitalized patients with elevated body mass index (BMI) and compare these with coding rates of other cardiometabolic risk factors.
METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional analysis of adults hospitalized between 2013 and 2023 with BMI ≥ 30 kg/m² and no prior coded obesity or bariatric surgery. Obesity and metabolic comorbidities were identified via ICD-9 codes.
RESULTS: Among 42,243 eligible adults (mean age 60.9 ± 16.9 years; 49.7% women; mean BMI 33.9 ± 3.9 kg/m²), only 10.6% had obesity documented at discharge. The likelihood of coding increased by 17% for each additional BMI unit (OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.16-1.18). Documentation was associated with higher utilization of obesity-related care, including metabolic clinic attendance (OR 2.26, 95% CI 2.05-2.49), bariatric surgery (OR 3.51, 95% CI 2.74-4.51), and GLP-1 receptor agonist prescriptions (OR 3.44, 95% CI 2.76-4.28). In comparison, diabetes was documented in 59.7% of patients with HbA1c ≥ 6.5%, and severe dyslipidemia in 39.0% of those with LDL-C ≥ 190 mg/dL.
CONCLUSIONS: Despite being objectively measurable, obesity remains substantially underdocumented compared with other cardiometabolic risk factors. Documentation was associated with greater uptake of metabolic clinic visits, bariatric surgery, and GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy. As effective obesity treatments become routine practice, closing this documentation gap is a prerequisite for translating measured BMI into actionable care.
items.authors: Avivi Ido, Zelmanoff Daniel D, Golan Netanel, Arbel Yaron
items.summary_ja: 2013年から2023年に入院したBMI≥30 kg/m²で既往に肥満コードまたは肥満手術の既往がない成人42,243例を対象とした横断的解析。退院時の肥満文書化率は10.6%のみであり、他の心代謝リスク因子（糖尿病59.7%、重症脂質異常症39.0%）と比較して著しく低かった。肥満の文書化は代謝外来受診（OR 2.26）、肥満手術（OR 3.51）、GLP-1受容体作動薬の処方（OR 3.44）と関連していた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 客観的に測定可能な肥満は、他の心代謝リスク因子と比較して依然として著しく文書化不足であり、この文書化ギャップの解消は測定されたBMIを実践的なケアに変換するための前提条件である。
items.why_matters_ja: 効果的な肥満治療が標準的な診療になるにつれ、肥満の文書化ギャップを解消することは、測定されたBMIを実践的なケアに変換するための前提条件となる。文書化の有無が代謝外来受診、肥満手術、GLP-1受容体作動薬療法の利用率に影響することを示し、臨床現場におけるドキュメント管理の改善が患者アウトカムに直結することを示唆する。
items.study_type_ja: 横断的解析（retrospective cross-sectional analysis）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：BMI≥30 kg/m²の入院患者における退院時の肥満文書化率。副次エンドポイント：他の心代謝リスク因子（糖尿病、重症脂質異常症）との文書化率の比較、肥満文書化と肥満関連ケアの利用率（代謝外来受診、肥満手術、GLP-1受容体作動薬処方）との関連。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 退院時の肥満文書化率：10.6%。BMI 1単位増加あたりの文書化オッズ比：OR 1.17（95% CI 1.16-1.18）。肥満文書化と代謝外来受診：OR 2.26（95% CI 2.05-2.49）。肥満文書化と肥満手術：OR 3.51（95% CI 2.74-4.51）。肥満文書化とGLP-1受容体作動薬処方：OR 3.44（95% CI 2.76-4.28）。糖尿病文書化率（HbA1c≥6.5%の患者）：59.7%。重症脂質異常症文書化率（LDL-C≥190 mg/dLの患者）：39.0%。

items.title: Late-life semaglutide treatment slows ageing and extends lifespan in female mice.
items.abstract: Pharmacological glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor (GLP-1R) activation reduces food intake and is an effective therapy for type 2 diabetes and obesity1. The use of GLP-1 medicines has revealed pleiotropic beneficial effects beyond glucose and weight control2-5, but little is known about the underlying basis of the pleiotropic effects. Here, treatment of 20-month-old female C57BL/6 mice with the GLP-1R agonist semaglutide for 3 months improved physiological function, attenuated hallmarks of ageing and modulated nutrient sensors and conserved genetic regulators of ageing. Continued treatment extended mouse lifespan. These effects parallel key features of calorie restriction, a dietary intervention that slows ageing, extends lifespan and alleviates a wide spectrum of ageing-associated diseases6. In a longitudinal study in direct comparison to matched calorie restriction, semaglutide treatment preserved baseline function and recapitulated many functional benefits of calorie restriction by attenuating age-associated decline, while also producing improvements above baseline and more favourable trajectories than calorie restriction in exploratory drive, spatial memory and glucose control. Together, these findings demonstrate that GLP-1R activation initiated late in life slows ageing and extends lifespan in female mice, supporting its function as a calorie restriction mimetic and providing a mechanistic framework that may help to explain its broad beneficial effects while revealing effects beyond those attributable to reduced calorie intake.
items.authors: Feng Yufan, Barthez Marine, Wang Yifei, Chen Yibing, Qiu Huixian, Wang Chih-Ling, Heydari Kartoosh, Delcroix Melaine
items.summary_ja: 20ヶ月齢の雌性C57BL/6マウスにGLP-1Rアゴニストであるセマグルチドを3ヶ月間投与したところ、生理機能の改善、老化の指標の軽減、栄養センサーおよび保存された老化遺伝子調節因子の調節が認められた。継続投与によりマウスの寿命が延長された。直接比較した縦断研究において、セマグルチド投与は基準機能を保ち、カロリー制限の多くの機能的利益を再現するとともに、探索的駆動、空間記憶、グルコース制御において基準値以上の改善とカロリー制限よりも好ましい推移を示した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 生涯の后期に開始したGLP-1R活性化は、雌性マウスにおいて老化を遅らせ寿命を延長し、カロリー制限ミメティックとしての機能を支持する。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1R活性化の広範な有益効果の説明に役立つ機能的枠組みを提供するとともに、カロリー摂取量の減少に帰因される以上の効果を明らかにする。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床動物実験（雌性マウス、縦断研究、カロリー制限との直接比較）
items.endpoints_ja: 生理機能、老化の指標、栄養センサーおよび保存された老化遺伝子調節因子、寿命、探索的駆動、空間記憶、グルコース制御

items.title: Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2 Inhibition in Diabetic Macular Oedema: Emerging Evidence for Stage-Dependent Systemic-Retinal Responsiveness.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors exert systemic cardiometabolic, renal and vascular effects that may influence retinal health, yet whether their effects on diabetic macular oedema (DMO) are stage-dependent remains unclear. We synthesized real-world, interventional and mechanistic evidence on responsiveness across disease stages and retinal phenotypes.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: In this scoping review (PRISMA-ScR; prospectively registered, UMIN000061304), we searched PubMed, the Cochrane Library, ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO-ICTRP and Google Scholar for studies published from January 2014 to April 2026. Two reviewers independently screened and charted records. Heterogeneity precluded meta-analysis, so a qualitative meta-summary with exploratory E-value analyses was performed.
RESULTS: Forty studies were included. Large administrative databases consistently associated SGLT2 inhibitor use with a 16%-35% lower DMO incidence (hazard ratio 0.65-0.84) and hazard ratios of 0.53-0.94 for diabetic retinopathy progression. In established DMO, observational studies reported hazard ratios of 0.39-0.81 for anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) injections, corticosteroid therapy and repeat vitrectomy, with the first-vitrectomy estimate non-significant, and attenuation in severe non-proliferative or proliferative retinopathy. The only randomized trial (COMET) did not meet its primary endpoint; its fellow-eye and phenotype-specific subgroup analyses were exploratory and hypothesis-generating. Proposed mechanisms include suppression of microglial activation, oxidative stress and angiopoietin-2/VEGF signalling, although translational evidence remains preclinical.
CONCLUSIONS: This predominantly observational evidence suggests that SGLT2 inhibitors may be associated with slower DMO disease kinetics across retinopathy stages, with reduced treatment burden most evident before severe retinopathy. Systemic SGLT2 inhibition may complement, rather than replace, anti-VEGF therapy, which remains the cornerstone of DMO management. These findings support prospective stage- and phenotype-stratified investigation.
items.authors: Ishibashi Ryoichi, Hirayama Kiichi, Sakai Toshiki, Tatsumi Tomoaki, Takatsuna Yoko, Baba Takayuki, Koshizaka Masaya, Yokote Koutaro
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬が糖尿病性黄斑浮腫（DMO）に及ぼす影響について、疾患段階および網膜表現型に応じた反応性を評価するため、実世界データ、介入研究、機序研究の証拠を統合したスコーピングレビュー（PRISMA-ScR、UMIN000061304）。2014年1月から2026年4月までに発表された研究をPubMed、Cochrane Library、ClinicalTrials.gov、WHO-ICTRP、Google Scholarから検索し、40研究を含む。異質性の高さからメタ分析は実施できず、定性的メタサマリーと探索的E-value解析を行った。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の使用は、網膜症段階を問わずDMOの疾患動態の遅延と関連し、治療負荷の軽減は重度網膜症以前に最も顕著である。SGLT2阻害薬は抗VEGF療法を代替するのではなく、補完的に機能する可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: DMOは糖尿病における視力喪失の主要な原因であり、SGLT2阻害薬はすでに心代謝・腎臓適応で広く使用されている。これらの薬剤がDMOの発症率や治療負荷を低減する可能性が示唆されれば、既存の糖尿病治療における網膜保護効果の追加的利点として臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: スコーピングレビュー（PRISMA-ScR）、定性的メタサマリーおよび探索的E-value解析
items.endpoints_ja: DMO発症、糖尿病性網膜症の進行、抗VEGF注射、コルチコステロイド療法、再硝子体切除術、初回硝子体切除術
items.endpoint_results_ja: DMO発症：16%-35%低減（ハザード比0.65-0.84）。糖尿病性網膜症の進行：ハザード比0.53-0.94。確立したDMOにおける抗VEGF注射・コルチコステロイド療法・再硝子体切除術：ハザード比0.39-0.81。初回硝子体切除術：有意差なし。唯一のランダム化試験（COMET）：主要エンドポイントを達成しなかった。

items.title: Where the Future Lies: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists as Therapeutics for Dermatologic Comorbidities.
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have transformed the management of obesity, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and cardiometabolic disease through effects on weight reduction, glycemic control, and systemic inflammation. Their varied immunometabolic actions have generated increasing interest in dermatology, where chronic inflammatory skin diseases frequently coexist with obesity, insulin resistance, metabolic syndrome, and cardiovascular disease. Emerging evidence from clinical trials, observational studies, and real-world analyses suggests that GLP-1RAs may improve outcomes in psoriasis and hidradenitis suppurativa while simultaneously reducing the burden of associated metabolic and cardiovascular comorbidities. In psoriasis, combination therapy with tirzepatide has demonstrated enhanced skin clearance, substantial weight loss, and reduced risk of psoriatic arthritis. In hidradenitis suppurativa, GLP-1RAs have been associated with improvements in cardiometabolic outcomes and reductions in systemic complications. Collectively, these findings support an evolving paradigm in which the greatest therapeutic utility of GLP-1RAs in dermatology may lie not in direct modulation of cutaneous inflammation but in addressing the metabolic dysfunction and chronic systemic inflammation that drive disease severity and multimorbidity. We review the current clinical evidence and propose a conceptual framework positioning GLP-1RAs as immune-metabolic therapies that target the systemic comorbidities of inflammatory skin disease, which may provide future opportunities for cutaneous disease modification and integrated dermatologic care.
items.authors: DeCoster Mikaela, Narla Shanthi
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）が肥満、2型糖尿病、心代謝性疾患の管理を変革してきた背景のもと、慢性炎症性皮膚疾患（乾癬、化膿性汗腺炎）におけるGLP-1RAの応用可能性をレビューした総説である。臨床試験、観察研究、実世界解析からの証拠を統合し、GLP-1RAを免疫代謝療法として位置づける概念的枠組みを提案している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1RAの皮膚科における最大の治療的有用性は、皮膚炎症の直接的な調節ではなく、疾患重症度と多疾患併存を駆動する代謝機能不全および慢性全身性炎症に対処することにある可能性が示唆された。
items.why_matters_ja: 乾癬や化膿性汗腺炎では、肥満・インスリン抵抗性・代謝症候群・心血管疾患が頻繁に併存しており、GLP-1RAが皮膚疾患の転帰改善と関連する代謝・心血管合併症の負担軽減を同時に実現できる可能性がある。これにより、皮膚疾患修飾と統合的皮膚科ケアの将来の機会が提供される。
items.study_type_ja: 総説（Review）
items.endpoints_ja: 乾癬：皮膚クリアランス、体重減少、乾癬性関節炎リスク。化膿性汗腺炎：心代謝性アウトカム、全身性合併症。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に具体的な数値は記載なし。乾癬ではtirzepatide併用療法で「enhanced skin clearance, substantial weight loss, and reduced risk of psoriatic arthritis」が示されたと記載。化膿性汗腺炎では「improvements in cardiometabolic outcomes and reductions in systemic complications」と記載。

items.title: Brca1 heterozygosity leads to hepatic steatosis in male and female mice despite sexually dimorphic effects on systemic metabolism.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Carrying a germline BRCA1 mutation increases the risk of several cancers, including breast and ovarian cancer. While BRCA1 is best known for its role in DNA damage repair, emerging evidence suggests broader functions in metabolic regulation.
METHODS: To determine whether heterozygous loss of Brca1, as occurs in individuals carrying a germline mutation, modifies susceptibility to diet-induced metabolic dysfunction in a sex-dependent manner, wild-type (WT) and Brca1+/- mice of both sexes were fed a low-fat diet (LFD) or high-fat diet (HFD) and underwent longitudinal metabolic phenotyping.
RESULTS: Female HFD-fed Brca1+/- mice exhibited exacerbated obesity, increased adiposity, hyperinsulinemia, and impaired glucose tolerance compared with WT controls. In contrast, male Brca1+/- mice showed modest resistance to HFD-induced weight gain and improved glucose tolerance. Human genetic analyses supported an association between BRCA1 and metabolic traits, including BMI, type 2 diabetes and liver fat accumulation. Despite divergent systemic metabolic phenotypes, Brca1 heterozygosity increased susceptibility to HFD-induced hepatic steatosis in both sexes. In HFD-fed female Brca1+/- mice, steatosis was associated with transcriptional remodeling linked to lipid accumulation and oxidative stress responses, together with reduced mitochondrial respiratory complex IV activity, altered mitochondrial morphology, lower hepatic ATP levels. Treatment with the dual GLP‑1/GIP receptor agonist tirzepatide improved systemic metabolic dysfunction and hepatic steatosis in HFD-fed female Brca1+/- mice.
CONCLUSIONS: These findings identify Brca1 heterozygosity as a modifier of metabolic disease susceptibility and expand the biological role of BRCA1 beyond tumor suppression to include the regulation of metabolic health.
items.authors: Palikhe Sailesh, Qiao Linlan, Kutz Caleb, Liang Xiaobo, Dhorajiya Poojaben, Koestler Devin C, Bhardwaj Priya, McCoin Colin S
items.summary_ja: BRCA1ヘテロ接合欠損が食餌誘発性代謝異常に与える影響を、WTおよびBrca1+/-マウス（両性）を用いた縦断的代謝フェノタイピングにより検討した。雌マウスではHFD下で肥満・脂肪蓄積・高インスリン血症・糖耐量異常がWT対照比で悪化したが、雄マウスではHFD誘発性体重増加への抵抗性と糖耐量改善が認められた。ヒト遺伝学的解析でもBRCA1とBMI・2型糖尿病・肝脂肪蓄積との関連が支持された。全身代謝表現型が性差を示すにもかかわらず、両性においてHFD誘発性肝脂肪変性の感受性がBrca1ヘテロ接合により増強された。雌マウスでは肝脂肪変性が脂質蓄積・酸化ストレス応答関連の転写再編成、ミトコンドリア呼吸複合体IV活性の低下、ミトコンドリア形態異常、肝臓ATPレベル低下と関連していた。GLP-1/GIP受容体二重作動薬tirzepatideの投与により、雌マウスの全身代謝異常と肝脂肪変性が改善された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: BRCA1ヘテロ接合欠損は全身代謝への影響が性差を示すものの、両性においてHFD誘発性肝脂肪変性の感受性を増強させる。
items.why_matters_ja: BRCA1の生物学的役割を腫瘍抑制から代謝健康の調節へと拡張し、BRCA1遺伝子変異保有者の代謝疾患感受性に関する新たな知見を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床動物実験（マウスモデル）およびヒト遺伝学的関連解析
items.endpoints_ja: 体重、肥満度、脂肪量、インスリン血症、糖耐量、肝脂肪変性、肝臓の転写プロファイル、ミトコンドリア呼吸複合体IV活性、ミトコンドリア形態、肝臓ATPレベル

items.title: Effects and Safety of Henagliflozin on Cardiac Structure in Dialysis Patients with Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Few effective drug treatments exist for dialysis patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). This study aimed to evaluate the effects of henagliflozin, a sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor, on cardiac structure, and its safety in such population.
METHODS: In this multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, dialysis patients with HFpEF were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive henagliflozin or placebo for 24 weeks. All enrolled participants received conventional therapy. The primary outcome was the change in left ventricular mass index (LVMI) from baseline to week 24. The secondary outcomes were the changes in left atrial volume index (LAVI), E/e', e', and N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) and safety. Efficacy was assessed in the intention-to-treat population. Safety was assessed in the as-treated population. Analysis of covariance was used to assess treatment effects.
RESULTS: A total of 112 participants were randomly assigned to the henagliflozin group (n=56) and the placebo group (n=56). Of these, 60 participants were on hemodialysis and 52 were on peritoneal dialysis. From baseline to week 24, henagliflozin resulted in a greater reduction inleast-squares mean (±SE) change in LVMI than placebo (-3.27±1.71 g/m2 versus 2.01±1.69 g/m2), with a between-group difference of -5.27 g/m2 (95% confidence interval [CI], -10.02 to -0.53 g/m2; P=0.03). In the prespecified subgroup by dialysis modality, the between-group difference in LVMI change from baseline to week 24 was -6.86 g/m2 (95% CI, -14.02 to 0.29 g/m2) among participants on peritoneal dialysis and -3.91 g/m2 (95% CI, -10.45 to 2.63 g/m2) among participants on hemodialysis. No between-group differences in secondary outcomes were observed. The incidence of adverse events was similar between the henagliflozin and placebo groups (36% vs. 34%).
CONCLUSIONS: Henagliflozin was associated with a greater reduction in LVMI at week 24 compared with placebo and was tolerable in dialysis patients with HFpEF. Larger studies are needed to confirm the LVMI-lowering effect of henagliflozin.
items.journal: Clinical journal of the American Society of Nephrology : CJASN
items.authors: Yan Hao, Wang Wei, Wu Wangshu, Li Ying, Qi Yinghui, Zhou Yijun, Zhang Weiming, Liu Shang
items.summary_ja: 透析患者におけるHFpEF（保存型心拍出量心不全）に対するSGLT2阻害薬ヘナグリフロジンの心臓構造への効果と安全性を評価した多施設・無作為化・二重盲検・プラセボ対照試験。透析中のHFpEF患者112名を1:1でヘナグリフロジン群（n=56）とプラセボ群（n=56）に無作為割付し、24週間投与した。主要評価項目はベースラインから24週目までの左室質量指数（LVMI）の変化量であった。ヘナグリフロジン群はプラセボ群と比較してLVMIの減少が有意に大きく（群間差 -5.27 g/m²、95%CI -10.02〜-0.53、P=0.03）、二次評価項目には群間差は認められなかった。有害事象の発生率は両群で同程度（36% vs 34%）であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ヘナグリフロジンは透析中のHFpEF患者においてプラセボと比較して24週目でLVMIを有意に減少させ、安全性・忍容性も良好であった。
items.why_matters_ja: 透析中のHFpEF患者に対する有効な薬物治療は限られており、SGLT2阻害薬がこの未充足の医療ニーズに対して心臓構造の改善をもたらす可能性を示した点で意義がある。
items.study_type_ja: 多施設・無作為化・二重盲検・プラセボ対照試験
items.endpoints_ja: 主要評価項目：ベースラインから24週目までの左室質量指数（LVMI）の変化量。二次評価項目：左房容積指数（LAVI）、E/e'、e'、NT-proBNPの変化量および安全性。
items.endpoint_results_ja: LVMIの変化量（最小二乗平均±SE）：ヘナグリフロジン群 -3.27±1.71 g/m² vs プラセボ群 2.01±1.69 g/m²、群間差 -5.27 g/m²（95%CI -10.02〜-0.53 g/m²、P=0.03）。腹膜透析サブグループ：群間差 -6.86 g/m²（95%CI -14.02〜0.29 g/m²）。血液透析サブグループ：群間差 -3.91 g/m²（95%CI -10.45〜2.63 g/m²）。二次評価項目（LAVI、E/e'、e'、NT-proBNP）には群間差は認められなかった。有害事象の発生率：ヘナグリフロジン群 36% vs プラセボ群 34%。
items.sample_size_ja: 112名（ヘナグリフロジン群 n=56、プラセボ群 n=56）。内訳：血液透析 60名、腹膜透析 52名。

items.title: Pharmacological management of obesity: Current landscape and emerging therapies.
items.abstract: Obesity is now recognized as a chronic, multifactorial, and progressive disease as opposed to mere excess of body weight. It significantly increases the risk of type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, metabolic-associated fatty liver disease, and mental health disorders. 2022 data reveal that nearly 3 billion individuals worldwide were living with either obesity or overweight. Pharmacological therapy has evolved remarkably. Earlier medications targeted primarily the brain's monoaminergic pathways but they were withdrawn due to safety concerns. Currently, six medications (Orlistat, Phentermine/Topiramate, Naltrexone/Bupropion, Liraglutide, Semaglutide, and Tirzepatide) are approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for long-term obesity management and among these, glucagon-like peptide receptor agonists have revolutionized the therapy. The emerging pipeline is even more promising. It has new dual and triple combinations such as CagriSema, Survodutide, and Retatrutide for better efficacy and metabolic outcomes, as well as long-acting and oral formulations, which will improve adherence and accessibility. India released its new obesity guideline in January 2025, emphasizing on early pharmacotherapy initiation and the adoption of stage-based obesity classification. Together, these developments signify a transformative era in obesity care where pharmacotherapy is a powerful and evidence-based tool that, in many cases, approaches the efficacy and metabolic benefits traditionally associated with bariatric surgeries.
items.authors: Atal Shubham, Agrawal Chirag, Gupta Rahul, Sadasivam Balakrishnan
items.summary_ja: 肥満は慢性・多因子性・進行性疾患として認識されており、2型糖尿病、心血管疾患、代謝関連脂肪肝疾患、精神疾患のリスクを大きく増加させる。2022年のデータでは、世界中で約30億人が肥満または過体重である。薬物療法は大きく進化し、現在米国FDAで長期肥満管理に承認されている6剤（オルリスタット、フェンテルミン/トピラマート、ナルトレキソン/ブプロピオン、リラグルチド、セマグルチド、tirzepatide）があり、中でもGLP-1受容体作動薬が治療を革新した。今後のパイプラインにはCagriSema、Survodutide、Retatrutideなどの新規デュアル・トリプル併用療法や、長作用・経口製剤が含まれる。インドは2025年1月に新たな肥満ガイドラインを発表し、早期薬物療法開始と段階別肥満分類の採用を強調している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満の薬物療法はGLP-1受容体作動薬の登場により大きく革新され、多くの症例で従来は腹腔内手術にのみ期待されていた有効性や代謝的恩恵に近づいている。
items.why_matters_ja: 世界中で約30億人が肥満または過体重であり、肥満は重大な合併症リスクを伴う。薬物療法が腹腔内手術に匹敵する有効性を示すようになったことは、肥満治療のアクセスとアウトカムに大きな転換点をもたらす。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: Integrating the liver into the cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome: pathophysiology and therapeutic implications.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: This review examines the mechanistic, epidemiological and therapeutic evidence underpinning liver integration into the cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) construct. For the purposes of this review, we use the term cardiovascular-renal-hepatic-metabolic (CRHM) syndrome to denote this expanded framework, acknowledging that consensus nomenclature is yet to be established.
RECENT FINDINGS: Large cohort data confirm that coexistent metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and CKD confer additive, stage-dependent mortality risk exceeding that of either condition alone, with hepatic fibrosis severity, rather than steatosis, the dominant prognostic driver. The past 12-18 months have seen significant therapeutic developments spanning the full CRHM spectrum. Resmetirom, a hepato-selective thyroid hormone receptor-β (THR-β) agonist, received FDA-accelerated approval (March 2024) and European Commission conditional marketing authorization (August 2025) as the first licensed metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH)-specific therapy; UK approval is pending. Incretin-based therapies demonstrated efficacy across the full CRHM spectrum: semaglutide in diabetic and non-diabetic kidney disease across FLOW, SELECT, and SMART trials; tirzepatide in obesity-related heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) in SUMMIT. Semaglutide additionally received accelerated FDA approval and EU marketing authorization for MASH following the ESSENCE trial; UK approval for this indication is pending.
SUMMARY: The integration of the liver into CKM staging now has implications for how clinicians stratify risk and select therapy. Early identification of MASLD in CKD cohorts using validated noninvasive fibrosis tools should be considered standard practice in high-risk populations.
items.journal: Current opinion in nephrology and hypertension
items.authors: Marshall William R, Sinha Smeeta, Green Darren, Kalra Philip A
items.summary_ja: 心血管-腎-代謝（CKM）症候群に肝臓を統合した心血管-腎-肝-代謝（CRHM）症候群の枠組みについて、病態生理学的・疫学的・治療的証拠をレビューした。MASLDとCKDの併存は単独疾患より高い段階依存性死亡リスクを付加的に付与し、肝線維化の重症度が脂肪沈着よりも主要な予後因子であることが大規模コホートデータで確認された。治療面では、resmetirom（THR-β作動薬）がMASH特異的治療としてFDA加速承認（2024年3月）およびEU条件付き承認（2025年8月）を取得し、incretin系療法（semaglutide、tirzepatide）がCRHMスペクトラム全体で有効性を示した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: MASLDとCKDの併存は単独疾患を超えた付加的な段階依存性死亡リスクを付与し、肝線維化の重症度が予後の主要な駆動因子である。肝臓のCKMステージングへの統合は、臨床医のリスク層別化と治療選択に直接的な影響を与える。
items.why_matters_ja: CKM症候群に肝臓を統合することで、高リスク集団におけるMASLDの早期同定（検証済み非侵襲的線維化ツールを用いたCKDコホートでのスクリーニング）が標準的な実践となるべきであり、リスク層別化と治療選択の戦略が変化する可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（総説）
items.endpoints_ja: 死亡リスク（MASLDとCKD併存時の段階依存性死亡リスク）、肝線維化の重症度（予後因子としての評価）

items.title: Repurposing SGLT2 inhibitors in pulmonary arterial hypertension: A multi-center longitudinal pilot study demonstrating favorable effects on risk profile and ventricular coupling.
items.abstract: BackgroundSodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2 inhibitors) confer broad cardiovascular benefits, but their role in pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) remains unclear.ObjectiveTo investigate the potential therapeutic role of SGLT2 inhibitors in PAH by evaluating their longitudinal association, including improvement in risk profile, functional status, and ventricular coupling.DesignMulticenter retrospective longitudinal pilot study.MethodsAdults with Group 1 PAH confirmed by right heart catheterization were followed and categorized by exposure to SGLT2 inhibitors. Time-to-clinical improvement was assessed using Cox proportional hazard models adjusted for age, gender, PAH etiology, pulmonary vascular resistance, and baseline risk profile. Two predefined endpoints were evaluated: (1) improvement by ≥ 1 category in a four-level risk stratification, and (2) achievement of a low-risk profile. Longitudinal changes in functional, biomarkers, and echocardiographic measures were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models adjusting for relevant covariates.ResultsAmong 83 patients with PAH, 43 received SGLT2 inhibitors. SGLT2 inhibitor use was independently associated with a higher rate of improvement by ≥ 1 risk category (hazard ratio [HR] 2.21, 95%CI 1.06-4.63; p = 0.034) and a higher likelihood of achieving a low risk profile (HR 2.62, 95% CI 1.02-6.76; p = 0.045). Longitudinal improvement was observed across the cohort in six-minute walk distance, Borg dyspnea score, B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) levels, and composite risk score (all p <0.001), with SGLT2 inhibitor use associated with greater improvement in persistently lower log-BNP levels during follow-up (p = 0.007). Echocardiographic demonstrated reductions in pulmonary artery systolic pressure and improvement in RV-pulmonary artery coupling over time.ConclusionIn this real-world cohort, SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with a higher likelihood of clinical improvement and achieving a low-risk profile in PAH, alongside favorable longitudinal changes in biomarkers and hemodynamics. Prospective randomized trials are warranted.
items.authors: Zou Yifan, Ahmad Ashfaq, Zhang Songlin, Wang Yousen, Ren Qian, Wang Heng, Li Lingling, Wang Xiaoyu
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の肺動脈性肺高血圧（PAH）における治療的役割を評価するため、右心カテータリゼーションでGroup 1 PAHと確認された成人患者を対象に、SGLT2阻害薬曝露の有無で分類し、リスクプロファイルの改善、機能状態、心室結合の縦断的関連を調査した多施設後ろ向き縦断的パイロット研究。83例中43例がSGLT2阻害薬を使用。Cox比例ハザードモデル（年齢、性別、PAH病因、肺血管抵抗、ベースラインリスクプロファイルで調整）および線形混合効果モデルを用いて解析。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の使用は、PAH患者においてリスクカテゴリー1段階以上の改善（HR 2.21, 95%CI 1.06-4.63; p=0.034）および低リスクプロファイルの達成（HR 2.62, 95%CI 1.02-6.76; p=0.045）と独立に関連し、フォローアップ中のlog-BNPの持続的低下（p=0.007）およびRV-肺動脈結合の改善も認められた。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は広範な心血管系への有益な効果を示すが、PAHにおける役割は不明であった。本パイロット研究は、PAHにおけるSGLT2阻害薬の潜在的な治療的役割を示唆し、前向きランダム化試験の必要性を支持する。
items.study_type_ja: 多施設後ろ向き縦断的パイロット研究（実世界コホート）
items.endpoints_ja: 事前定義エンドポイント：(1) 4段階リスク分類における1段階以上の改善、(2) 低リスクプロファイルの達成。二次的評価：機能状態（6分歩行距離、Borg呼吸困難スコア）、バイオマーカー（BNP、複合リスクスコア）、心エコー所見（肺動脈収縮期血圧、RV-肺動脈結合）の縦断的変化。
items.sample_size_ja: PAH患者83例（うちSGLT2阻害薬使用43例）

items.title: Multi-Database Pharmacovigilance Analysis of Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease Associated with GLP-1 Receptor Agonists: A Cross-National Signal Validation Study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND/AIMS: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are widely prescribed for type 2 diabetes and obesity. Gastrointestinal adverse events are common; however, the association with gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) has not been validated across diverse populations. We aimed to assess GERD signals associated with GLP-1 RAs using disproportionality analysis across three national adverse event reporting systems.
METHODS: We analyzed FAERS, JADER, and Canada Vigilance. GLP-1 RAs were compared against dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors as active comparators. GERD was identified using MedDRA preferred terms. Reporting odds ratios (RORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated. Subgroup analyses were performed by drug, age, and sex.
RESULTS: Among 260,417 GLP-1 RA reports, significant GERD signals were detected across all databases: FAERS (ROR, 2.83; 95% CI, 2.39 to 3.35; 9,245 vs 139), JADER (4.76; 95% CI, 2.45 to 9.27; 19 vs 16), and Canada Vigilance (2.91; 95% CI, 1.97 to 4.31; 206 vs 29). All signals met both ROR and proportional reporting ratio detection criteria. Drug-specific analyses revealed the strongest signals for semaglutide across all databases (3.44 to 6.93), followed by liraglutide (2.36 to 5.90), tirzepatide (2.76 to 5.77), and dulaglutide (2.35 to 3.32). Exenatide showed an inverse association in FAERS (ROR, 0.60; 95% CI, 0.46 to 0.77). Age-stratified analysis demonstrated increasing signal strength with age (≥65 years: ROR, 3.01; p-trend=0.028). Sensitivity analysis confirmed consistent signal directions.
CONCLUSIONS: This first multi-database pharmacovigilance analysis confirms consistent GERD signals for GLP-1 RAs across Western and Asian populations, demonstrating approximately 2- to 5-fold higher reporting. Clinicians need to monitor for reflux symptoms during GLP-1 RA therapy, particularly in elderly patients.
items.authors: Choi Jeong-Gyu, Gong Eun Jeong, Bang Chang Seok, Lee Jae Jun
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RAs）と胃食道逆流症（GERD）の関連を、FAERS、JADER、Canada Vigilanceの3つの国家レベルの有害事象報告システムを用いて不均衡分析（disproportionality analysis）により評価した。DPP-4阻害薬を活性比較薬とし、MedDRA優先用語でGERDを同定し、報告オッズ比（ROR）と95%信頼区間を算出した。全データベースで有意なGERDシグナルが検出され、セマグルチドが最も強いシグナルを示した。年齢別解析では65歳以上でシグナル強度が増加した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1 RAsはGERDの報告オッズを約2〜5倍上昇させるシグナルを、西洋系およびアジア系の複数データベースで一貫して示した。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1 RA治療中の逆流症状のモニタリング、特に高齢患者において臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 多データベース薬物警戒（pharmacovigilance）シグナル検証研究（不均衡分析）
items.endpoints_ja: GERD（MedDRA優先用語による同定）の報告オッズ比（ROR）および95%信頼区間
items.endpoint_results_ja: FAERS: ROR 2.83（95% CI 2.39〜3.35; 9,245 vs 139）; JADER: ROR 4.76（95% CI 2.45〜9.27; 19 vs 16）; Canada Vigilance: ROR 2.91（95% CI 1.97〜4.31; 206 vs 29）。薬剤別: セマグルチド 3.44〜6.93、リラグチド 2.36〜5.90、tirzepatide 2.76〜5.77、デュラグルチド 2.35〜3.32。Exenatide（FAERS）: ROR 0.60（95% CI 0.46〜0.77）。65歳以上: ROR 3.01（p-trend=0.028）。
items.sample_size_ja: GLP-1 RA報告 260,417件（FAERS: 9,245 vs 139、JADER: 19 vs 16、Canada Vigilance: 206 vs 29）

items.title: Cardiometabolic outcomes of once-weekly IcoSema in adults with type 2 diabetes: systematic review and meta-analysis of the COMBINE trials.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Patients with type 2 diabetes face a high residual risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) despite advances in therapy. Once-weekly IcoSema, a fixed-ratio combination of basal insulin icodec and semaglutide, offers the potential to simultaneously address glycemic control, weight, and multiple cardiometabolic risk factors with a single weekly injection.
METHODS: We conducted a PRISMA-compliant systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of randomized trials from the COMBINE program. Data from COMBINE 1 (active comparator: once-weekly insulin icodec) and COMBINE 3 (active comparator: basal-bolus insulin therapy) (N = 1,970) were pooled comparing IcoSema with insulin-based intensification strategies in patients inadequately controlled on basal insulin. COMBINE 2 was excluded because its semaglutide monotherapy comparator addresses a fundamentally different clinical question (escalation from GLP-1 RA monotherapy). The primary focus was on changes in body weight, Systolic blood pressure and HbA1c; key secondary outcomes included changes in lipid profile relevant to ASCVD risk. Certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE.
RESULTS: IcoSema showed no statistically significant difference in HbA1c reduction compared with control (pooled MD -0.37%, 95% CI -0.95 to 0.21; P = 0.21; I²=98%) but shows highly significant body weight reduction (pooled MD -6.10 kg, 95% CI -7.21 to -5.00; P < 0.00001). It significantly lowered systolic blood pressure (MD -2.45 mmHg, 95% CI -3.52 to -1.38; P < 0.00001), total cholesterol (ETR 0.97, 95% CI 0.95-0.98; P = 0.0001), LDL-C (ETR 0.94, 95% CI 0.90-0.98; P = 0.005), triglycerides (ETR 0.94, 95% CI 0.91-0.97; P = 0.0006), and VLDL-C (ETR 0.94). An exploratory, hypothetical ASCVD risk modeling analysis based on these surrogate-marker changes is presented in the Supplementary Appendix and is intended as an illustration only.
CONCLUSIONS: Once-weekly IcoSema delivers meaningful improvements in weight, blood pressure, and atherogenic lipids, all key modifiable drivers of ASCVD in adults with type 2 diabetes. These surrogate benefits, combined with reduced injection burden and low risk of hypoglycemia, suggest potential for enhanced ASCVD prevention and improved long-term adherence. Results should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating only because only two trials met the inclusion criteria. Dedicated cardiovascular outcome trials are essential to validate these surrogate-marker benefits and to confirm whether they translate into a reduction in cardiovascular events.
items.authors: Alper Adir, Fagin Adina, Karthikeyan Aditya, Lerner Mathias, Gershon Adam, Morgan Ahmed Ashraf, Rubinstein Gal, Agarwal Raksheeth
items.summary_ja: COMBINEプログラム（COMBINE 1およびCOMBINE 3、N=1,970）のランダム化試験を対象としたPRISMA準拠の系統的レビューおよびランダム効果メタ解析。ベースラインインスリンで不十分管理の2型糖尿病患者において、週1回IcoSema（基礎インスリンicodecとセマグルチドの固定比率配合）をインスリン強化戦略と比較し、体重・収縮期血圧・HbA1cの変化を主要評価項目、ASCVDリスクに関連する脂質プロファイルの変化を主要二次評価項目として評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: IcoSemaはHbA1c低下において対照群と有意差を認めなかったが、体重（-6.10 kg）、収縮期血圧（-2.45 mmHg）、およびアテロゲン性脂質（総コレステロール、LDL-C、トリグリセリド、VLDL-C）において対照群と比較して統計学的に有意な改善を示した。ただし、対象となった試験が2試験のみであるため、結果は仮説生成に留まる。
items.why_matters_ja: 2型糖尿病患者は治療の進歩にもかかわらず動脈硬化性心血管疾患（ASCVD）の残余リスクが高い。IcoSemaは単一の週1回注射で血糖管理・体重・複数の心血管代謝リスク因子を同時に改善する可能性を持ち、ASCVD予防の強化および長期アドヒアランスの改善に寄与し得る。
items.study_type_ja: 系統的レビューおよびメタ解析（PRISMA準拠、ランダム効果モデル）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要評価項目：体重変化、収縮期血圧変化、HbA1c変化。主要二次評価項目：ASCVDリスクに関連する脂質プロファイルの変化（総コレステロール、LDL-C、トリグリセリド、VLDL-C）。

items.title: Investigating the Relationship Between Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonist Use and Incidence of Vertebral Fractures in Female Patients Aged Over 50 Years With Osteoporosis: A Propensity-Matched Analysis.
items.abstract:
STUDY DESIGN: Retrospective cohort.
OBJECTIVE: To investigate the relationship between GLP-1 receptor agonist exposure and incidence of vertebral fracture and surgical intervention for these injuries in patients with osteoporosis.
SUMMARY OF BACKGROUND DATA: Vertebral fractures are relatively common in patients with osteoporosis and frequently result in substantial morbidity, such as persistent pain and functional deficit. Although primarily indicated for the management of type 2 diabetes mellitus and obesity, glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) have demonstrated positive effects on bone mineral density (BMD) in the lumbar spine. However, it remains unknown if this effect translates to positive clinical outcomes for patients with osteoporosis.
METHODS: This study utilized the TriNetX database to identify female patients aged over 50 years diagnosed with osteoporosis without a current pathologic fracture within the 10-year period ended January 1, 2025. The study group included patients with a history of GLP-1 RA use after osteoporosis diagnosis compared with a control group with no GLP-1 RA exposure. Cohorts were propensity-matched based on baseline demographic characteristics, BMI, HbA1c, eGFR, medical comorbidities, osteoporotic medication use, and serum calcium, phosphate, and vitamin D levels. Primary outcomes included incidence of vertebral collapse and vertebral augmentation within the 10-year study period.
RESULTS: There were 56,142 matched pairs. The rate of vertebral fracture in the experimental group was ∼1.9% compared with 4.3% in the control group (RR: 0.434, 95% CI: 0.404-0.467, P<0.001). In addition, GLP-1 RA exposure was associated with a lower incidence of kyphoplasty or vertebroplasty (RR: 0.453, 95% CI: 0.381-0.538, P<0.001).
CONCLUSION: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist use is associated with a lower incidence of vertebral fracture and osteoporotic fracture intervention in female patients aged 50+ with osteoporosis. These findings underscore the potential protective effects of GLP-1 receptor agonists in patients with poor bone quality.
LEVEL OF EVIDENCE: Level III.
items.authors: Stump Kyle, Kelleher Sean, Aynaszyan Stephan, Ricci Samuel, Pazionis Theresa
items.summary_ja: TriNetXデータベースを用いた後方視コホート研究で、50歳以上の骨粗鬆症を有する女性患者において、GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）の使用と脊椎骨折の発生率および脊椎増強術との関連を調査した。ベースライン特性に基づいてプロパensityマッチングを行い、56,142対のマッチ対を解析した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 50歳以上の骨粗鬆症を有する女性患者において、GLP-1受容体作動薬の使用は脊椎骨折の発生率および骨粗鬆症性骨折に対する介入（キフォプラストイまたはバーテブロプラストイ）の発生率の低下と関連していた。
items.why_matters_ja: 脊椎骨折は骨粗鬆症患者に比較的多く、持続痛や機能障害などの重大な合併症を引き起こす。GLP-1 RAは腰椎の骨密度に好影響を示すが、それが臨床的アウトカムに転換されるかは不明であった。本研究は、骨質の悪い患者におけるGLP-1 RAの潜在的な保護効果を示唆する。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート研究（プロパensityマッチング解析）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：10年間の研究期間における脊椎崩壊（vertebral collapse）の発生率および脊椎増強（vertebral augmentation）の発生率
items.endpoint_results_ja: 脊椎骨折の発生率：実験群 約1.9% vs 対照群 4.3%（RR: 0.434, 95% CI: 0.404-0.467, P<0.001）。キフォプラストイまたはバーテブロプラストイの発生率：RR: 0.453, 95% CI: 0.381-0.538, P<0.001。

items.title: Patient-Reported Continuity of GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Therapy.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Use of GLP-1 receptor agonists is associated with significant weight loss in many individuals. Discontinuation is associated with weight regain. Patients' experience with this is not well characterized. This study describes the patient experience of continuity of care.
METHODS: A cross-sectional electronic survey was administered to adults identified from an academic medical center's electronic health records as having at least one GLP-1 RA prescription in the preceding 6 years and a subsequent prescription gap of greater than 90 days. The 87-item instrument spanned six domains: care settings, comorbidity and treatment context, continuity, discontinuity, dietitian/lifestyle support, and digital-feature preferences. Primary outcomes were item-level frequencies. Exploratory composites included a 7-item Continuity-of-Care Index (CCI) and a 5-item Discontinuity Index (DIS), each rescaled 0-100; subgroup comparisons used Kruskal-Wallis, Mann-Whitney, and chi-square tests, with multiple-imputation sensitivity analyses.
RESULTS: Of 4890 invitations, 261 adults completed the survey (5.3%); 143 (54.8%) reported current use of a prescription weight-management medication and 159 (60.9%) reported prior-authorization requirements. Among them, 79 (49.7%) either waited more than 7 days or were never approved. Continuity strengths included knowing whom to contact about medications (76.2%) and timely team responses (70.7%); the weakest items were cross-clinic coordination (54.1%) and visibility into required next steps (52.2%). The CCI (mean 69.5 [SD 22.7]; α = 0.90; n = 242) varied by most-visited clinic (Kruskal-Wallis p < 0.001), highest at the weight-management clinic (median 82.1) and lower at primary care (60.7). Among current medication users, 32.4% reported a ≥ 14-day medication gap. The most desired digital features were all-in-one tracking of refills, prior authorization, and appointments (89.5%) and real-time prior-authorization status (87.2%).
CONCLUSIONS: Patients described obesity-care disruptions primarily as process failures, including prior authorization delay, out-of-pocket cost, pharmacy stock-outs and dispensing delays, and fragmented cross-clinic coordination. They prioritized transparent, workflow-oriented navigation.
items.authors: Chen You, Piantek Gracie, Zhang Xinmeng, Feng Yubo, Yan Chao, Samuels Jason M, Rosenbloom S Trent, Yu Danxia
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体アゴニスト（GLP-1 RA）の継続的治療における患者報告のケアの連続性（continuity of care）を評価した横断的電子調査研究。学術医療センターの電子カルテから、過去6年間にGLP-1 RA処方歴があり、その後90日以上の処方ギャップが生じた成人を特定し、87項目の調査票を配布した。4,890件の招待に対し261名が回答（5.3%）。主要アウトカムは項目レベルの頻度であり、探索的複合指標として7項目のContinuity-of-Care Index（CCI）と5項目のDiscontinuity Index（DIS）を算出した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 患者は肥満ケアの中断を主にプロセス上の失敗（事前承認の遅延、自己負担費用、薬局の在庫切れ・調剤遅延、クリニック間の断片的な連携）として報告し、透明性のあるワークフロー指向のナビゲーションを優先した。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1 RAの中止は体重の再増加と関連しており、患者報告に基づくケア継続の障壁の理解は、治療アドヒアランスを維持するためのシステムレベルの改善に寄与しうる。
items.study_type_ja: 横断的電子調査（cross-sectional electronic survey）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：項目レベルの頻度。探索的複合指標：7項目のContinuity-of-Care Index（CCI）および5項目のDiscontinuity Index（DIS）、いずれも0-100に再スケーリング。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 回答者261名（招待4,890件のうち5.3%）。処方体重管理薬の現在使用：143名（54.8%）。事前承認要件の報告：159名（60.9%）。7日以上の待機または未承認：79名（49.7%）。薬剤に関する連絡先を把握：76.2%。チームの迅速な対応：70.7%。クリニック間の連携：54.1%。必要な次のステップの可視性：52.2%。CCI平均69.5（SD 22.7）、α=0.90、n=242。CCIは最頻来院クリニックで有意に異なる（Kruskal-Wallis p<0.001）：体重管理クリニック中央値82.1、プライマリケア60.7。現在薬剤使用患者のうち14日以上の薬剤ギャップを報告：32.4%。最も望ましいデジタル機能：リフィル・事前承認・予約の一元管理89.5%、リアルタイム事前承認ステータス87.2%。

items.title: Incretin-based therapies in diabetic kidney disease: toward integrated cardio-kidney-metabolic disease modification.
items.abstract: Obesity and type 2 diabetes (T2D) are dominant drivers of chronic kidney disease (CKD) within the cardio-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome. Despite advances with renin-angiotensin system inhibitors and sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors, substantial residual cardiovascular and renal risk persists, highlighting the need for therapies targeting upstream metabolic dysfunction. Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists (RAs) have emerged as key modulators of CKM disease through integrated metabolic, vascular, and anti-inflammatory mechanisms. Cardiovascular outcome trials first established their cardioprotective effects, while the FLOW trial definitively demonstrated kidney protection, showing a 24% reduction in major kidney outcomes in patients with T2D and CKD. Mechanistic insights from translational studies further suggest that GLP-1 receptor activation promotes metabolic decongestion, improves intrarenal hemodynamics, and attenuates inflammatory and fibrotic pathways. Beyond selective GLP-1 receptor agonism, dual (glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide [GIP]/GLP-1) and triple (GIP/GLP-1/glucagon) incretin agonists, including tirzepatide and retatrutide, extend this paradigm by delivering greater weight reduction and systemic metabolic reprogramming, with emerging signals for cardiovascular and renal benefit. Contemporary CKD management is shifting toward a phenotype-driven, layered therapeutic strategy in which SGLT2 inhibitors provide foundational kidney protection and incretin-based therapies are integrated to address residual metabolic and cardiovascular risk. In this evolving CKM framework, incretin-based therapies represent a central component of multi-mechanistic disease modification, extending beyond glycemic control to coordinated protection across the heart, kidney, and metabolic systems.
items.authors: Kim Yaeni, Lee Eun Young
items.summary_ja: 肥満と2型糖尿病（T2D）は心臓・腎臓・代謝（CKM）症候群における慢性腎臓病（CKD）の主要な駆動因子である。レニン・アンギオテンシン系阻害薬やSGLT2阻害薬の進歩にもかかわらず、心血管・腎臓の残存リスクは依然として大きい。GLP-1受容体作動薬（RA）は統合的な代謝・血管・抗炎症メカニズムを通じてCKM疾患の重要な調節因子として台頭している。心血管アウトカム試験が心保護効果を確立し、FLOW試験はT2D合併CKD患者において主要腎アウトカムを24%減少させる腎保護効果を明確に示した。さらに、GIP/GLP-1二重作動薬やGIP/GLP-1/グルカゴン三重作動薬（tirzepatide、retatrutide）はより大きな減量と全身代謝再プログラミングを提供し、心血管・腎臓への有益なシグナルが示されている。現在のCKD管理は、SGLT2阻害薬が基礎的な腎保護を提供し、インクレチン系療法が残存する代謝・心血管リスクに対処するよう統合される、フェノタイプ駆動型の多層的治療戦略へと移行しつつある。
items.key_takeaway_ja: インクレチン系療法は血糖管理を超え、心臓・腎臓・代謝システムにまたがる協調的な保護を提供する多メカニズム疾患修飾の中心的構成要素である。
items.why_matters_ja: レニン・アンギオテンシン系阻害薬やSGLT2阻害薬の進歩にもかかわらず、心血管・腎臓の残存リスクが依然として大きく、上流の代謝異常を標的とする治療の必要性が示されている。

items.title: Initiation of SGLT2 Inhibitors Versus DPP-4 Inhibitors in Metformin Users and Risk of Incident Depression: A Nationwide, Claims-Based Active-Comparator New-User Study.
items.abstract:
AIMS: To examine the association between initiation of sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors and risk of incident depression compared with dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (DPP-4) inhibitors among adults with newly diagnosed Type 2 diabetes receiving metformin.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: We conducted a nationwide active-comparator new-user cohort study with a 90-day adherent-survivor landmark design, using the Korean National Health Insurance Service database linked with national health check-up and mortality data (2014-2022). Adults with newly diagnosed Type 2 diabetes receiving metformin who newly initiated SGLT2 inhibitors or DPP-4 inhibitors as add-on therapy were identified. This study was designed as a 90-day adherent-survivor landmark analysis. Propensity score matching was performed in a 1:1 ratio, yielding 10 013 matched pairs. The primary outcome was incident depression, defined as ≥ 2 outpatient or inpatient claims with ICD-10 codes F32-F33. The secondary outcome was suicide mortality. Cox proportional hazards models were used to estimate hazard ratios (HRs) under intention-to-treat and as-treated approaches.
RESULTS: Among 38 297 eligible participants, 300 depression events occurred among SGLT2 inhibitor users and 391 among DPP-4 inhibitor users in the matched cohort. Initiation of SGLT2 inhibitors was associated with a lower risk of depression compared with DPP-4 inhibitors (HR 0.85, 95% CI 0.73-0.99). Similar findings were observed in as-treated analyses (HR 0.80, 95% CI 0.65-0.98). Associations were generally consistent across clinically relevant subgroups and appeared more pronounced among older adults, females and individuals with greater comorbidity burden. Suicide mortality was infrequent in both groups.
CONCLUSIONS: Among 90-day adherent survivors with Type 2 diabetes receiving metformin, initiation of SGLT2 inhibitors as add-on therapy was associated with a lower risk of incident depression compared with DPP-4 inhibitors.
items.authors: Park Sangwoo, Jeong Seogsong, Kim Hye Jun, Lee Dae Ho, Choi Soo Jung, Park Sang Min
items.summary_ja: メトホルミン使用中の新規診断2型糖尿病患者において、SGLT2阻害薬とDPP-4阻害薬の開始が新規うつ病リスクに与える影響を評価した全国規模のクレームベース・アクティブコンパレーター・ニューユーザーコホート研究。韓国国民健康保険サービスデータベース（2014-2022年）を用い、90日アディherent-survivorランドマークデザインを採用。傾向スコアマッチング（1:1）により10,013対のマッチ済みコホートを構築した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: メトホルミン使用中の2型糖尿病患者において、SGLT2阻害薬の開始はDPP-4阻害薬と比較して新規うつ病リスクが有意に低かった（HR 0.85, 95% CI 0.73-0.99）。
items.why_matters_ja: 2型糖尿病の追加療法としてSGLT2阻害薬を選択することで、DPP-4阻害薬と比較してうつ病リスクの低下が期待できる可能性を示唆しており、薬剤選択時の精神科的な副次的利益の観点から臨床的に意義がある。
items.study_type_ja: 全国規模のクレームベース・アクティブコンパレーター・ニューユーザーコホート研究（90日アディherent-survivorランドマークデザイン、傾向スコアマッチング）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：新規うつ病（ICD-10コードF32-F33による外来または入院クレーム2件以上）。二次エンドポイント：自殺死亡率。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 主要エンドポイント（新規うつ病）：ITT解析 HR 0.85, 95% CI 0.73-0.99；as-treated解析 HR 0.80, 95% CI 0.65-0.98。二次エンドポイント（自殺死亡率）：両群とも頻度は低かった（具体的な数値は記載なし）。

items.title: Incretin-Based Therapies as Cardiometabolic Interventions: Outcome Hierarchy, Receptor-Network Pharmacology and Phenotype-Based Clinical Positioning.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Incretin-based pharmacotherapy was initially developed to improve glucose-dependent insulin secretion and glycaemic control in type 2 diabetes, but its clinical interpretation has expanded substantially with cardiovascular outcome trials, kidney outcome data, obesity studies and next-generation polyagonist development. This narrative clinical review uses structured literature identification and outcome-stratified synthesis to evaluate incretin-based therapies as cardiometabolic interventions across diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular disease and chronic kidney disease.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: The available evidence was interpreted according to therapeutic class, clinical domain, outcome maturity and safety boundaries, integrating clinical outcome evidence with receptor-network pharmacology.
RESULTS: Selected GLP-1 receptor agonists are supported by hard cardiovascular and renal outcome data, whereas several dual, triple, amylin-linked and oral small-molecule strategies are currently supported mainly by glycaemic, weight-loss, metabolic or early translational endpoints. This distinction is clinically important because treatment positioning should depend on patient phenotype, outcome maturity and safety boundaries rather than mechanistic plausibility alone. In patients with type 2 diabetes and established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, GLP-1 receptor agonists with proven cardiovascular outcome benefit should be prioritised when atherosclerotic risk reduction is a major treatment goal. In type 2 diabetes with chronic kidney disease, semaglutide has dedicated kidney outcome evidence. In obesity with cardiometabolic risk, high-magnitude and sustained weight reduction has become a clinically relevant therapeutic target. Receptor-network pharmacology, including GLP-1, GIP, glucagon and amylin receptor signalling, provides a useful explanatory framework for heterogeneous efficacy, tolerability and tissue-level effects.
CONCLUSIONS: However, clinical use remains bounded by gastrointestinal tolerability, lean-mass preservation, treatment durability, discontinuation effects and long-term safety. This review therefore proposes phenotype-based clinical positioning rather than a prescriptive treatment algorithm.
items.authors: Sztanek Ferenc, Lőrincz Hajnalka, Harangi Mariann, Nagy Attila Csaba
items.summary_ja: インクリチン系薬物療法は当初、2型糖尿病におけるグルコース依存性インスリン分泌の改善と血糖コントロールのために開発されたが、心血管アウトカム試験、腎臓アウトカムデータ、肥満研究、次世代ポリアゴニストの開発により、その臨床的解釈は大幅に拡大している。本叙述的臨床レビューは、構造化文献検索とアウトカム階層別統合を用い、糖尿病・肥満・心血管疾患・慢性腎臓病にまたがるインクリチン系療法を心代謝介入として評価した。選択されたGLP-1受容体アゴニストは確立された心血管・腎臓アウトカムデータにより支持される一方、デュアル・トリプル・アミリン関連・経口小分子戦略の多くは主に血糖・減量・代謝・初期トランスレーショナルエンドポイントにより支持されている。受容体ネットワーク薬理学（GLP-1、GIP、グルカゴン、アミリン受容体シグナリング）は、異質な有効性・耐容性・組織レベル効果の有用な説明枠組みを提供する。臨床利用は消化管耐容性、痩せ体組織の保持、治療持続性、中止効果、長期安全性により制限される。
items.key_takeaway_ja: インクリチン系療法の治療ポジショニングは、患者のフェノタイプ、アウトカムの成熟度、安全性境界に基づいて行うべきであり、単なる機能的妥当性だけでは不十分である。確立された動脈硬化性心血管疾患を有する2型糖尿病患者では、心血管アウトカム利益が証明されたGLP-1受容体アゴニストを優先すべきであり、慢性腎臓病を伴う2型糖尿病ではセマグルチドが専用の腎臓アウトカム証拠を有する。
items.why_matters_ja: インクリチン系療法の臨床的解釈が心血管・腎臓・肥満の領域に大幅に拡大した背景下で、アウトカムの成熟度と患者フェノタイプに基づく体系的な臨床ポジショニングの枠組みを提供し、治療意思決定の根拠となる。
items.study_type_ja: 叙述的臨床レビュー（Narrative Clinical Review）
items.endpoints_ja: 心血管アウトカム（硬い心血管イベント）、腎臓アウトカム、血糖コントロール、減量、代謝エンドポイント、初期トランスレーショナルエンドポイント、消化管耐容性、痩せ体組織保持、治療持続性、中止効果、長期安全性

items.title: Higher semaglutide dose is associated with lower neuropsychiatric event incidence independent of weight loss.
items.abstract: GLP1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have transformed obesity treatment, but their impact on neuropsychiatric outcomes remains poorly understood. We conducted an observational study of 63,215 patients with preexisting neuropsychiatric conditions and evaluated 24 incident neuropsychiatric outcomes following treatment initiation. In propensity-matched analyses, semaglutide was associated with broadly lower neuropsychiatric event risk over two years compared with metformin, SGLT2 inhibitors, and DPP-4 inhibitors. Within the semaglutide-treated cohort, higher attained dose during the first two years after treatment initiation ("pre-landmark period") was associated with significantly lower incidence during the subsequent two years ("post-landmark period") of substance-related disorders (P < 0.001), mood disorders (P < 0.001), anxiety- and stress-related disorders (P < 0.001), central nervous system (CNS) atrophies (P < 0.001), neuromuscular disorders (P = 0.013), eating/sleep/behavioral disorders (P = 0.022), and personality/impulse-control disorders (P = 0.028). Consistent with prior clinical trials, the post-landmark incidence of dementia or CNS degenerative diseases was similar between the high-dose and low-dose semaglutide cohorts (P = 0.15). For most neuropsychiatric diagnoses, post-landmark incidence was strongly associated with the maximum attained dose. In contrast, incident cognitive symptoms and speech/language symptoms were more closely associated with weight loss (p < 0.001 and p < 0.003, respectively). Bulk and single-cell transcriptomic analyses identified low-level, regionally restricted GLP1R transcript signals in central and peripheral nervous system tissues, providing hypothesis-generating context for future experimental investigation. Together, these findings support an association between semaglutide exposure and multiple neuropsychiatric outcomes, and motivate prospective mechanistic and clinical studies.
items.authors: Murugadoss Karthik, Venkatakrishnan A J, Soundararajan Venky
items.summary_ja: 既存の神経精神疾患を有する63,215例を対象とした観察研究であり、治療開始後の24の神経精神疾患新規発症アウトカムを評価した。プロパティスコアマッチング解析により、セマグルチドはメトホルミン、SGLT2阻害薬、DPP-4阻害薬と比較して2年間にわたり広範に低い神経精神イベントリスクと関連した。セマグルチド投与コホート内では、治療開始後最初の2年間の到達最高用量が高いほど、その後の2年間の物質関連障害（P<0.001）、気分障害（P<0.001）、不安・ストレス関連障害（P<0.001）、中枢神経系萎縮（P<0.001）、神経筋障害（P=0.013）、摂食・睡眠・行動障害（P=0.022）、人格・衝動制御障害（P=0.028）の発症率が有意に低かった。認知症または中枢神経系変性疾患の発症率は高用量群と低用量群で同程度であった（P=0.15）。認知症状および言語症状は減量とより強く関連した（p<0.001、p<0.003）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチドの到達用量が高いほど、減量に依存せずに神経精神イベントの発症率が低いことが示された。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬は肥満治療を変革したが、神経精神系アウトカムへの影響は十分に理解されていない。本研究はセマグルチド曝露と複数の神経精神系アウトカムとの関連を支持し、前向きな機序研究および臨床研究の必要性を提示する。

items.endpoints_ja: 24の神経精神疾患新規発症アウトカム（物質関連障害、気分障害、不安・ストレス関連障害、中枢神経系萎縮、神経筋障害、摂食・睡眠・行動障害、人格・衝動制御障害、認知症または中枢神経系変性疾患、認知症状、言語症状など）

items.title: Trials and tribulations of spironolactone in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction: Insights from the SPIRIT-HF trial.
items.abstract: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction represents a clinical challenge, accounting for at least 50% of heart failure (HF) cases globally, with a historical lack of efficacious and disease-modifying therapies. Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists, specifically the steroidal agent spironolactone, have a strong theoretical potential to mitigate systemic inflammation, microvascular endothelial dysfunction, and myocardial fibrosis, which commonly affect patients with HF. However, the clinical validation of spironolactone has been influenced by methodological inconsistencies and safety concerns. The pivotal TOPCAT trial yielded neutral primary outcome results globally, confounded by significant geographical disparities. To provide further evidence the SPIRIT-HF trial evaluated spironolactone in a population with HF and mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction. This trial was affected by critical operational issues related to the COVID-19 pandemic, resulting in an underpowered study population with a very high study drug discontinuation rate. The trial ultimately failed to demonstrate a cardiovascular benefit on any of the evaluated outcomes. The ongoing SPIRRIT-HFpEF trial represents a pragmatic, registry-based study to overcome traditional enrollment barriers, while evidence from the FINEARTS-HF trial on finerenone, a novel non-steroidal antagonist, has finally highlighted a major role for mineralocorticoid receptor antagonism in patients with HF and mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction. This meeting report examines the SPIRIT-HF trial and place its results within the broader evidence on steroidal and nonsteroidal MRA in patients with HFpEF.
items.authors: Basile Christian, Monzo Luca, Farmakis Dimitrios, Keramida Kalliopi, Liori Sotiria, Kapelios Chris J, Sverdlov Aaron L, Grupper Avishay
items.summary_ja: 本稿はSPIRIT-HF試験の会議報告であり、HFpEFにおけるスピロノラクトンの臨床検証の経緯を概観する。TOPCAT試験は地理的偏りにより主要アウトカムが中立であった。SPIRIT-HF試験はCOVID-19パンデミックによる運営上の問題により、被験者数が不足し、試験薬の中止率が非常に高かった。最終的に心血管上の利益はどの評価アウトカムでも示されなかった。一方、非ステロイド性MRAであるフィネロノンを対象としたFINEARTS-HF試験は、HFpEFにおけるMRA阻害の重要な役割を初めて示した。本報告はSPIRIT-HFの結果をステロイド性及び非ステロイド性MRAのより広いエビデンスの文脈に位置づけている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SPIRIT-HF試験は被験者数不足と高い中止率により、スピロノラクトンの心血管上の利益をどのアウトカムでも示せなかった。一方、非ステロイド性MRAであるフィネロノンを対象としたFINEARTS-HF試験は、HFpEFにおけるMRA阻害の重要な役割を初めて示した。
items.why_matters_ja: HFpEFは世界的にHF症例の少なくとも50%を占め、歴史的に有効な疾患修飾療法が欠如していた。ステロイド性MRAであるスピロノラクトンが失敗した理由と、非ステロイド性MRAであるフィネロノンが成功した理由の理解は、HFpEF治療戦略の方向性を示す上で重要である。

items.title: Dapagliflozin in pulmonary arterial hypertension and chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension: The DAPAH randomized controlled trial.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: SGLT2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) reduce mortality in left heart failure. In pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), preclinical data suggest SGLT2i improve right ventricular function through metabolic modulation and inhibition of vascular remodeling via smooth muscle cell pathways. The DAPAH trial evaluated whether the potential benefits of SGLT2 inhibition translate into clinical efficacy for symptomatic patients on background vasodilator therapy with either PAH or chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension.
METHODS: In this single-center, double-blind trial, 52 patients were randomized (1:1) to dapagliflozin 10 mg daily or placebo for 12 weeks. The primary endpoint was change in Peak VO2. Secondary endpoints included invasive hemodynamics, NT-proBNP, 6-minute walk distance (6MWD) and REVEAL Lite 2 scores.
RESULTS: Baseline characteristics were balanced (n=52; mean age 66.5 years; 63% female; n=40 PAH, n=12 CTEPH). Fifty-one patients had complete data on Peak VO2. At 12 weeks, there was no significant difference in Peak VO2 (Adjusted Mean Difference: -0.67 mL/kg/min; 95% CI [-1.67, 0.33]; p=0.187). No significant treatment effects were observed for pulmonary vascular resistance (p=0.255), 6MWD (p=0.22), or NT-proBNP trajectory (interaction p=0.681). REVEAL Lite 2 scores showed a small reduction with dapagliflozin (-0.66; 95% CI [-1.25, -0.06]; p=0.031). Metabolic target engagement was evident from a significant reduction in serum urate (P-interaction < 0.001). Dapagliflozin was safe and well-tolerated.
CONCLUSION: This randomized study of SGLT2i in pre-capillary PH showed that 12 weeks of dapagliflozin did not significantly improve exercise capacity, hemodynamics, or functional status compared to placebo.
CLINICALTRIALS: gov (NCT05179356).

items.summary_ja: DAPAH試験は、背景の血管拡張薬治療中の症状性PAHまたはCTEPH患者において、ダパグリフロジン10 mg/日12週間の投与が運動耐容能を改善するかを評価した単一施設・二重盲検・無作為化対照試験である。52例が1:1でダパグリフロジン群またはプラセボ群に無作為化された。主要エンドポイントであるPeak VO2の変化には有意差を認めなかった。二次エンドポイント（肺血管抵抗、6MWD、NT-proBNP）にも有意な治療効果は認められなかった。REVEAL Lite 2スコアにはダパグリフロジン群で軽度の有意な低下が認められた。ダパグリフロジンは安全で忍容性も良好であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 前毛細血管性肺高血圧症患者において、12週間のダパグリフロジン投与はプラセボと比較して運動耐容能、血流力学、機能状態を有意に改善しなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は左心不全で死亡率を低下させることが示されており、前臨床データでは代謝調節および血管リモデリング抑制を介して右心機能の改善が示唆されていた。本試験は、これらの潜在的な利点が症状性PAH/CTEPH患者において臨床的有効性として転換されるかを検証したものであり、SGLT2阻害薬の右心不全・肺高血圧領域での役割を明確にする上で重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 単一施設・二重盲検・無作為化対照試験（RCT）、12週間
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：Peak VO2の変化。二次エンドポイント：侵襲的血流力学、NT-proBNP、6分間歩行距離（6MWD）、REVEAL Lite 2スコア。
items.endpoint_results_ja: Peak VO2：調整平均差 -0.67 mL/kg/min、95% CI [-1.67, 0.33]、p=0.187。肺血管抵抗：p=0.255。6MWD：p=0.22。NT-proBNP推移：交互作用 p=0.681。REVEAL Lite 2スコア：-0.66、95% CI [-1.25, -0.06]、p=0.031。血清尿酸：P-interaction < 0.001。

items.title: Sex in CKD trials: representation and treatment effects of cardiorenoprotective therapies.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Women comprise a substantial proportion of the chronic kidney disease (CKD) population and differ from men in disease phenotype, progression, and treatment exposure. Underrepresentation of women and limited sex-specific reporting may therefore reduce the generalizability of evidence from contemporary CKD trials.
METHODS: We conducted a meta-epidemiological study of randomized trials evaluating sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors, glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists, and non-steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists in adults with CKD. Female representation was quantified using the enrollment disparity difference (EDD), defined as the observed proportion of female trial participants minus the expected proportion derived from sex-specific Global Burden of Disease CKD prevalence estimates matched to trial population characteristics. Trial-level EDDs were pooled using random-effects meta-analysis. Meta-regression was used to examine trial-level correlates of EDD. Historical analyses extended the cohort to earlier cardiorenal pharmacotherapies to evaluate temporal trends, with pivotal CKD trials examined descriptively. Reporting of sex-specific cardiovascular and kidney outcomes was also assessed.
RESULTS: Fifty-five randomized trials were included. Median female enrollment was 33.1%, and 52 trials (94.5%) enrolled fewer women than expected. The pooled EDD was -0.17 (95% CI, -0.20; -0.14), with negative estimates across all intervention classes. In meta-regression, phase II design and albuminuria requirement were associated with greater female underrepresentation, whereas diabetes requirement and female first authorship were associated with smaller enrollment disparity, including after adjustment for other key trial characteristics. Sex-specific outcomes were reported in 13 trials (23.6%). Extension to 117 trials provided no statistically supported evidence of improvement in female representation over time, including after adjustment for intervention class; all 38 pivotal CKD trials enrolled fewer women than expected.
CONCLUSIONS: Women remain underrepresented in cardiorenoprotective therapy trials, with limited sex-specific outcome reporting. Historical benchmarking indicates that successive advances in CKD pharmacotherapy have not been accompanied by demonstrable improvement in the sex representativeness of the evidence base.
